**§11.4.240 — Producer ≠ Verifier scope separation: the actor that produces a change/artifact/verdict cannot be the one that gates it — least privilege over cleverness (research-derived, 2026-08-15).** Compact summary: every project MUST enforce STRUCTURAL SEPARATION between the actor that PRODUCES a change/artifact/verdict and the actor that GATES that same work — the producer cannot write, weaken, delete, or edit the acceptance tests, the oracle, the gate configuration, the verdict store, the paired §1.1 mutation, or any other check gating its own work; enforcement is by CAPABILITY (structurally cannot reach), never by INSTRUCTION (told not to reach), following the "least privilege over cleverness" principle (extraction line 1488 [un-resolvable offset per the §11.4.239 CITATION NOTE; MODULE CORRECTED 2026-08-20 — the quoted passage resolves to module 28, not module 27; verified locator `module_28:393`]: "the durable fix is least privilege over cleverness ... the load-bearing move is that the agent chasing the green gate cannot reach the gate, the oracle, or the evidence store"). (A) Four scopes MUST resolve to distinct actors — PRODUCER / ORACLE / GATE / VERIFIER; a two-scope-or-more collapse involving the producer is a §11.4.240 finding; (B) enforcement channels are filesystem scope / branch protection (§11.4.248 PROTECTED-SPEC + CODEOWNERS) / verdict-store isolation / clean-checkout execution isolation — NEVER prompts, policies, or social contracts (extraction line 5715 [un-resolvable offset per the §11.4.239 CITATION NOTE; module 34 attribution VERIFIED CORRECT 2026-08-20, verified locator `module_34:87`] catalogues "we told it in the prompt not to hardcode" as the shallow / red-flag answer); (C) three forbidden collapses named: PRODUCER=ORACLE (tautological testing), PRODUCER=GATE (weakened thresholds), PRODUCER=VERIFIER (self-certification); (D) composes with the existing verifier layer — §11.4.115(F) machine-written verdicts, §11.4.125/.142/.209 independent review, §11.4.146(D3) status custody, §11.4.135 release verdict coverage, §11.4.165 independent verifier agent, §11.4.245 oracle independence; (E) honest boundary — separation forbids the CLASS of self-certification, does NOT prove verifier correctness (§11.4.107(10) still binds). **(F) Independence-tier vocabulary + Tier-C capability-separation triggers, degrading honestly on a single-uid host (extension, spec-derived, speckit 002-anti-slop-enforcement, 2026-08-26).** Clauses (A)-(E) state the SEPARATION PRINCIPLE in the abstract; this clause supplies the CLOSED VOCABULARY for recording HOW MUCH separation was ACHIEVED, plus the two triggers that raise the required strength — because claiming "capability separation" where only "instance separation" is achievable is itself the theatre this anchor exists to prevent. **(1) Closed tier set:** every accepted verdict's recorded basis of independence MUST name its tier from the CLOSED SET `{instance, model, capability}` — `instance` (a separate agent/process instance sharing no in-flight state with the producer), `model` (a DIFFERENT model), `capability` (a genuine host-level access-control boundary separating the producer's write scope from the verifier's). **(2) Model diversity is PERMITTED, NEVER REQUIRED — the false-positive guard:** a verdict from an independent INSTANCE running the SAME model as the producer MUST be ACCEPTED on that basis alone; a check that refuses same-model independent verdicts is the exact class of false-positive refusal §11.4.201 forbids. This does NOT weaken the constitution's OTHER, narrower model-substrate pins — §11.4.256 (translation review runs on a DIFFERENT model/provider than the translator) and §11.4.209 (every mandatory independent code-review runs on Opus at `xhigh`, no fallback model) both remain in force unmodified for their own domains. **(3) Tier-C trigger 1 — producer holds write access to the evidence/verdict store:** the verdict MUST be written through the MOST RESTRICTIVE separation genuinely available on the host, and the ACHIEVED separation (not the aspired-to one) MUST be reported. **(4) Tier-C trigger 2 — the three named high-blast-radius seams:** at `release-tag`, `qa-deploy` or `manual-qa-handoff` (or the consumer's declared equivalents per §11.4.35) a producer-authored verdict is REFUSED regardless of the write-access analysis. **(5) No demand for capability outside the two triggers:** at a seam matching NEITHER trigger a separate agent INSTANCE MUST SUFFICE and capability separation MUST NOT be demanded — over-applying Tier-C strength to every seam is itself the same false-positive-refusal violation. **Honest boundary (§11.4.6):** on a SINGLE-UID host capability separation CANNOT be established by any mechanism an agent can set up — ownership defeats access-control lists, the append-only attribute requires privilege the agent lacks, and any key the producer can use it can also read — so such a host reports `instance` HONESTLY and never `capability`, until the operator takes the one host-boundary action agents are correctly forbidden from creating (§11.4.66/§12); the field records WHAT WAS ACHIEVED, never what was ASPIRED to, and honest degradation IS the compliant path. Recommended mechanism gate `CM-INDEPENDENCE-TIER-HONESTLY-RECORDED` + paired §1.1 mutation (record `capability` where no verified host boundary exists → MUST FAIL; refuse a same-model independent verdict at an ordinary seam → MUST FAIL; accept a producer-authored verdict at `release-tag`/`qa-deploy`/`manual-qa-handoff` → MUST FAIL; golden-FALSE per §11.4.201(1): an honest `instance`-tier verdict at an ordinary seam MUST NOT fire it); gate-code = separate work item, NOT claimed shipped (§11.4.6/§11.4.227). Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Composes §11.4.6/.20/.70/.92/.107(10)/.115(F)/.125/.134/.135/.142/.146(D3)/.165/.194/.201/.205/.209/.245/.248/.249 (mutual composes with §11.4.249 four-role + flight-recorder architecture per §11.4.209 reviewer MINOR-1 — §11.4.240 the separation principle, §11.4.249 the four-role taxonomy that instantiates it). Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-240-PROPAGATION` + recommended gates `CM-PRODUCER-NOT-VERIFIER-SCOPE-SPLIT` + `CM-LEAST-PRIVILEGE-CAPABILITY-NOT-INSTRUCTION` + paired §1.1 mutations. **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.240. Non-compliance is a release blocker. No escape hatch — no `--producer-may-write-tests`, `--self-certification-OK`, `--exhortation-suffices-as-enforcement`, `--producer-authored-verdict-accepted`, `--capability-limit-optional`, `--policy-document-is-enforcement`, `--single-actor-for-all-scopes` flag.

module 34 attribution VERIFIED CORRECT 2026-08-20, verified locator `module_34:87`] catalogues "we told it in the prompt not to hardcode" as the shallow / red-flag answer); (C) three forbidden collapses named: PRODUCER=ORACLE (tautological testing), PRODUCER=GATE (weakened thresholds), PRODUCER=VERIFIER (self-certification); (D) composes with the existing verifier layer — §11.4.115(F) machine-written verdicts, §11.4.125/.142/.209 independent review, §11.4.146(D3) status custody, §11.4.135 release verdict coverage, §11.4.165 independent verifier agent, §11.4.245 oracle independence; (E) honest boundary — separation forbids the CLASS of self-certification, does NOT prove verifier correctness (§11.4.107(10) still binds). **(F) Independence-tier vocabulary + Tier-C capability-separation triggers, degrading honestly on a single-uid host (extension, spec-derived, speckit 002-anti-slop-enforcement, 2026-08-26).** Clauses (A)-(E) state the SEPARATION PRINCIPLE in the abstract; this clause supplies the CLOSED VOCABULARY for recording HOW MUCH separation was ACHIEVED, plus the two triggers that raise the required strength — because claiming "capability separation" where only "instance separation" is achievable is itself the theatre this anchor exists to prevent. **(1) Closed tier set:** every accepted verdict's recorded basis of independence MUST name its tier from the CLOSED SET `{instance, model, capability}` — `instance` (a separate agent/process instance sharing no in-flight state with the producer), `model` (a DIFFERENT model), `capability` (a genuine host-level access-control boundary separating the producer's write scope from the verifier's). **(2) Model diversity is PERMITTED, NEVER REQUIRED — the false-positive guard:** a verdict from an independent INSTANCE running the SAME model as the producer MUST be ACCEPTED on that basis alone; a check that refuses same-model independent verdicts is the exact class of false-positive refusal §11.4.201 forbids. This does NOT weaken the constitution's OTHER, narrower model-substrate pins — §11.4.256 (translation review runs on a DIFFERENT model/provider than the translator) and §11.4.209 (every mandatory independent code-review runs on Opus at `xhigh`, no fallback model) both remain in force unmodified for their own domains. **(3) Tier-C trigger 1 — producer holds write access to the evidence/verdict store:** the verdict MUST be written through the MOST RESTRICTIVE separation genuinely available on the host, and the ACHIEVED separation (not the aspired-to one) MUST be reported. **(4) Tier-C trigger 2 — the three named high-blast-radius seams:** at `release-tag`, `qa-deploy` or `manual-qa-handoff` (or the consumer's declared equivalents per §11.4.35) a producer-authored verdict is REFUSED regardless of the write-access analysis. **(5) No demand for capability outside the two triggers:** at a seam matching NEITHER trigger a separate agent INSTANCE MUST SUFFICE and capability separation MUST NOT be demanded — over-applying Tier-C strength to every seam is itself the same false-positive-refusal violation. **Honest boundary (§11.4.6):** on a SINGLE-UID host capability separation CANNOT be established by any mechanism an agent can set up — ownership defeats access-control lists, the append-only attribute requires privilege the agent lacks, and any key the producer can use it can also read — so such a host reports `instance` HONESTLY and never `capability`, until the operator takes the one host-boundary action agents are correctly forbidden from creating (§11.4.66/§12); the field records WHAT WAS ACHIEVED, never what was ASPIRED to, and honest degradation IS the compliant path. Recommended mechanism gate `CM-INDEPENDENCE-TIER-HONESTLY-RECORDED` + paired §1.1 mutation (record `capability` where no verified host boundary exists → MUST FAIL; refuse a same-model independent verdict at an ordinary seam → MUST FAIL; accept a producer-authored verdict at `release-tag`/`qa-deploy`/`manual-qa-handoff` → MUST FAIL; golden-FALSE per §11.4.201(1): an honest `instance`-tier verdict at an ordinary seam MUST NOT fire it); gate-code = separate work item, NOT claimed shipped (§11.4.6/§11.4.227). Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Composes §11.4.6/.20/.70/.92/.107(10)/.115(F)/.125/.134/.135/.142/.146(D3)/.165/.194/.201/.205/.209/.245/.248/.249 (mutual composes with §11.4.249 four-role + flight-recorder architecture per §11.4.209 reviewer MINOR-1 — §11.4.240 the separation principle, §11.4.249 the four-role taxonomy that instantiates it). Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-240-PROPAGATION` + recommended gates `CM-PRODUCER-NOT-VERIFIER-SCOPE-SPLIT` + `CM-LEAST-PRIVILEGE-CAPABILITY-NOT-INSTRUCTION` + paired §1.1 mutations. **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.240. Non-compliance is a release blocker. No escape hatch — no `--producer-may-write-tests`, `--self-certification-OK`, `--exhortation-suffices-as-enforcement`, `--producer-authored-verdict-accepted`, `--capability-limit-optional`, `--policy-document-is-enforcement`, `--single-actor-for-all-scopes` flag.

a check that refuses same-model independent verdicts is the exact class of false-positive refusal §11.4.201 forbids. This does NOT weaken the constitution's OTHER, narrower model-substrate pins — §11.4.256 (translation review runs on a DIFFERENT model/provider than the translator) and §11.4.209 (every mandatory independent code-review runs on Opus at `xhigh`, no fallback model) both remain in force unmodified for their own domains. **(3) Tier-C trigger 1 — producer holds write access to the evidence/verdict store:** the verdict MUST be written through the MOST RESTRICTIVE separation genuinely available on the host, and the ACHIEVED separation (not the aspired-to one) MUST be reported. **(4) Tier-C trigger 2 — the three named high-blast-radius seams:** at `release-tag`, `qa-deploy` or `manual-qa-handoff` (or the consumer's declared equivalents per §11.4.35) a producer-authored verdict is REFUSED regardless of the write-access analysis. **(5) No demand for capability outside the two triggers:** at a seam matching NEITHER trigger a separate agent INSTANCE MUST SUFFICE and capability separation MUST NOT be demanded — over-applying Tier-C strength to every seam is itself the same false-positive-refusal violation. **Honest boundary (§11.4.6):** on a SINGLE-UID host capability separation CANNOT be established by any mechanism an agent can set up — ownership defeats access-control lists, the append-only attribute requires privilege the agent lacks, and any key the producer can use it can also read — so such a host reports `instance` HONESTLY and never `capability`, until the operator takes the one host-boundary action agents are correctly forbidden from creating (§11.4.66/§12); the field records WHAT WAS ACHIEVED, never what was ASPIRED to, and honest degradation IS the compliant path. Recommended mechanism gate `CM-INDEPENDENCE-TIER-HONESTLY-RECORDED` + paired §1.1 mutation (record `capability` where no verified host boundary exists → MUST FAIL; refuse a same-model independent verdict at an ordinary seam → MUST FAIL; accept a producer-authored verdict at `release-tag`/`qa-deploy`/`manual-qa-handoff` → MUST FAIL; golden-FALSE per §11.4.201(1): an honest `instance`-tier verdict at an ordinary seam MUST NOT fire it); gate-code = separate work item, NOT claimed shipped (§11.4.6/§11.4.227). Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Composes §11.4.6/.20/.70/.92/.107(10)/.115(F)/.125/.134/.135/.142/.146(D3)/.165/.194/.201/.205/.209/.245/.248/.249 (mutual composes with §11.4.249 four-role + flight-recorder architecture per §11.4.209 reviewer MINOR-1 — §11.4.240 the separation principle, §11.4.249 the four-role taxonomy that instantiates it). Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-240-PROPAGATION` + recommended gates `CM-PRODUCER-NOT-VERIFIER-SCOPE-SPLIT` + `CM-LEAST-PRIVILEGE-CAPABILITY-NOT-INSTRUCTION` + paired §1.1 mutations. **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.240. Non-compliance is a release blocker. No escape hatch — no `--producer-may-write-tests`, `--self-certification-OK`, `--exhortation-suffices-as-enforcement`, `--producer-authored-verdict-accepted`, `--capability-limit-optional`, `--policy-document-is-enforcement`, `--single-actor-for-all-scopes` flag.
**§11.4.240 — Producer ≠ Verifier scope separation: the actor that produces a change/artifact/verdict cannot be the one that gates it — least privilege over cleverness (research-derived, 2026-08-15).** Compact summary: every project MUST enforce STRUCTURAL SEPARATION between the actor that PRODUCES a change/artifact/verdict and the actor that GATES that same work — the producer cannot write, weaken, delete, or edit the acceptance tests, the oracle, the gate configuration, the verdict store, the paired §1.1 mutation, or any other check gating its own work; enforcement is by CAPABILITY (structurally cannot reach), never by INSTRUCTION (told not to reach), following the "least privilege over cleverness" principle (extraction line 1488 [un-resolvable offset per the §11.4.239 CITATION NOTE; MODULE CORRECTED 2026-08-20 — the quoted passage resolves to module 28, not module 27; verified locator `module_28:393`]: "the durable fix is least privilege over cleverness ... the load-bearing move is that the agent chasing the green gate cannot reach the gate, the oracle, or the evidence store"). (A) Four scopes MUST resolve to distinct actors — PRODUCER / ORACLE / GATE / VERIFIER; a two-scope-or-more collapse involving the producer is a §11.4.240 finding; (B) enforcement channels are filesystem scope / branch protection (§11.4.248 PROTECTED-SPEC + CODEOWNERS) / verdict-store isolation / clean-checkout execution isolation — NEVER prompts, policies, or social contracts (extraction line 5715 [un-resolvable offset per the §11.4.239 CITATION NOTE; module 34 attribution VERIFIED CORRECT 2026-08-20, verified locator `module_34:87`] catalogues "we told it in the prompt not to hardcode" as the shallow / red-flag answer); (C) three forbidden collapses named: PRODUCER=ORACLE (tautological testing), PRODUCER=GATE (weakened thresholds), PRODUCER=VERIFIER (self-certification); (D) composes with the existing verifier layer — §11.4.115(F) machine-written verdicts, §11.4.125/.142/.209 independent review, §11.4.146(D3) status custody, §11.4.135 release verdict coverage, §11.4.165 independent verifier agent, §11.4.245 oracle independence; (E) honest boundary — separation forbids the CLASS of self-certification, does NOT prove verifier correctness (§11.4.107(10) still binds). **(F) Independence-tier vocabulary + Tier-C capability-separation triggers, degrading honestly on a single-uid host (extension, spec-derived, speckit 002-anti-slop-enforcement, 2026-08-26).** Clauses (A)-(E) state the SEPARATION PRINCIPLE in the abstract; **§11.4.241 — Illegal-state-unrepresentability preference (types > API-shape > lint > property-test > runtime-assert) (research-derived, 2026-08-15).** Compact summary: every load-bearing invariant a change relies on MUST land at the STRONGEST enforcement rung the target language/toolchain supports, walking a closed ordered ladder — (1) TYPE SYSTEM (invalid state cannot be constructed: sum types / newtype wrappers / `NonEmpty` / opaque handles), (2) API SHAPE (only exposed constructor path enforces it: private constructors + smart factories, sealed hierarchies, capability tokens), (3) LINT (invalid pattern refused by tree before build), (4) PROPERTY-BASED TEST (invariant asserted across generator-driven input space), (5) RUNTIME ASSERTION (last-line guard raises when invalid state actually forms). Defect PREVENTABLE at rung N caught only at rung > N is a finding. Operator honest boundary 2026-08-15 — rungs 1-2 conditional on toolchain support (mypy present, TypeScript strict, Pydantic used), rungs 3-5 unconditional (every language has a linter + runtime). §1.1 mutation: drop the type constraint / relax `PositiveInt` to `int` / make private constructor public → compiler/type-checker/API gate FAILs to build; if it still builds, the rung was decoration. Composes §11.4.6 / §11.4.108 (pushes enforcement LEFT of Layer 1) / §11.4.115 / §11.4.142 / §11.4.194 / §11.4.201 / §11.4.224. Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-241-PROPAGATION` + recommended gate `CM-ILLEGAL-STATE-LADDER-PREFERENCE` + paired §1.1 mutation. **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.241. Non-compliance is a release blocker. No escape hatch — no `--runtime-assert-suffices`, `--skip-type-preference`, `--dynamic-language-exempts-all-rungs`, `--property-test-in-lieu-of-type`, `--decorative-type-annotation-OK` flag.

**§11.4.242 — Bisection-not-blame regression cause-finding + failure modes (research-derived, 2026-08-15).** Compact summary: regression localisation FIRST-choice mechanism is BISECTION (`git bisect`, O(log N)) over the range from the last known-good tag (§11.4.114) to current HEAD, NOT blame-log walking (O(N) linear) NOR speculative root-cause hunting (unbounded). Bisection produces the introducing commit as CAPTURED EVIDENCE (§11.4.5) feeding §11.4.102 systematic-debugging's root-cause phase with the actual change in hand. MONOTONE-SEARCH INVARIANT: bisection valid only when observable is monotone across the range (broken stays broken); non-monotone (flaky, environment-dependent, timing-race) MUST stabilise first — bisection over flaky signal produces WRONG "guilty" commit with same confidence as correct one. FAILURE-MODE CATALOGUE (closed): (1) flaky/non-monotone observable, (2) build-broken commits (mistaken for "bad", use `bisect skip`), (3) merge-commit introductions (defect in conflict resolution not either parent), (4) external/environmental changes (upstream dep, OS update), (5) delayed-fuse introductions (latent commit + later trigger), (6) test-infra regressions masquerading as product regressions. `git bisect run` script MUST use exit-code discipline (0=good, 1-124=bad, 125=skip); mapping every non-zero to "bad" collapses the taxonomy. Composes §11.4.5 / §11.4.6 / §11.4.69 / §11.4.102 / §11.4.114 / §11.4.115 / §11.4.201 / §11.4.224. Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-242-PROPAGATION` + recommended gate `CM-BISECTION-BEFORE-BLAME` + paired §1.1 mutation. **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.242. Non-compliance is a release blocker. No escape hatch — no `--blame-log-suffices`, `--skip-bisection`, `--flaky-observable-bisect-anyway`, `--run-script-exit-code-collapse-OK`, `--regression-guess-without-localisation` flag.
**§11.4.242 — Bisection-not-blame regression cause-finding + failure modes (research-derived, 2026-08-15).** Compact summary: regression localisation FIRST-choice mechanism is BISECTION (`git bisect`, O(log N)) over the range from the last known-good tag (§11.4.114) to current HEAD, NOT blame-log walking (O(N) linear) NOR speculative root-cause hunting (unbounded). Bisection produces the introducing commit as CAPTURED EVIDENCE (§11.4.5) feeding §11.4.102 systematic-debugging's root-cause phase with the actual change in hand. MONOTONE-SEARCH INVARIANT: bisection valid only when observable is monotone across the range (broken stays broken); non-monotone (flaky, environment-dependent, timing-race) MUST stabilise first — bisection over flaky signal produces WRONG "guilty" commit with same confidence as correct one. FAILURE-MODE CATALOGUE (closed): (1) flaky/non-monotone observable, (2) build-broken commits (mistaken for "bad", use `bisect skip`), (3) merge-commit introductions (defect in conflict resolution not either parent), (4) external/environmental changes (upstream dep, OS update), (5) delayed-fuse introductions (latent commit + later trigger), (6) test-infra regressions masquerading as product regressions. `git bisect run` script MUST use exit-code discipline (0=good, 1-124=bad, 125=skip); mapping every non-zero to "bad" collapses the taxonomy. Composes §11.4.5 / §11.4.6 / §11.4.69 / §11.4.102 / §11.4.114 / §11.4.115 / §11.4.201 / §11.4.224. Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-242-PROPAGATION` + recommended gate `CM-BISECTION-BEFORE-BLAME` + paired §1.1 mutation. **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.242. Non-compliance is a release blocker. **§11.4.243 — Characterization / golden-master safety net before behaviour-changing modification of legacy (research-derived, 2026-08-15).** Compact summary: before ANY behaviour-changing modification to code that qualifies as legacy (lacks tests asserting observable behaviour, or written spec diverges from actual, or predates the constitution's TDD discipline, or the modifier cannot describe its behaviour from reading source), the modifier MUST FIRST author CHARACTERIZATION TESTS — tests asserting the CURRENT observable behaviour as GROUND TRUTH whether "correct" or not — and land them as a green baseline. Only AFTER the safety net exists may the modification proceed; characterization tests then act as the oracle catching unintended behaviour changes. Pattern originates in Feathers's WORKING EFFECTIVELY WITH LEGACY CODE + generalises GOLDEN-MASTER (record outputs across representative input space; assert future runs match). Characterization is DESCRIPTIVE not prescriptive — it captures WHAT IS not WHAT SHOULD BE; if current behaviour is subtly wrong, ASK operator per §11.4.66 whether modification should preserve or correct it (never silently). Composes §11.4.5 / §11.4.6 / §11.4.66 / §11.4.108 / §11.4.115 (RED-first — characterization is legacy counterpart) / §11.4.118 (sampled input space = honest gaps, not completeness) / §11.4.124 (investigate-before-remove — parallel discipline) / §11.4.201 / §11.4.224 (test-first backfilled for legacy). Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-243-PROPAGATION` + recommended gate `CM-CHARACTERIZATION-BEFORE-LEGACY-MODIFICATION` + paired §1.1 mutation. **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.243. Non-compliance is a release blocker. No escape hatch — no `--modify-untested-legacy-directly`, `--skip-characterization`, `--claim-tests-not-needed-because-obvious`, `--decorative-assertion-suffices`, `--refactor-without-safety-net` flag.

Pattern originates in Feathers's WORKING EFFECTIVELY WITH LEGACY CODE + generalises GOLDEN-MASTER (record outputs across representative input space; assert future runs match). Characterization is DESCRIPTIVE not prescriptive — it captures WHAT IS not WHAT SHOULD BE; if current behaviour is subtly wrong, ASK operator per §11.4.66 whether modification should preserve or correct it (never silently). Composes §11.4.5 / §11.4.6 / §11.4.66 / §11.4.108 / §11.4.115 (RED-first — characterization is legacy counterpart) / §11.4.118 (sampled input space = honest gaps, not completeness) / §11.4.124 (investigate-before-remove — parallel discipline) / §11.4.201 / §11.4.224 (test-first backfilled for legacy). Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-243-PROPAGATION` + recommended gate `CM-CHARACTERIZATION-BEFORE-LEGACY-MODIFICATION` + paired §1.1 mutation. **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.243. Non-compliance is a release blocker. No escape hatch — no `--modify-untested-legacy-directly`, `--skip-characterization`, `--claim-tests-not-needed-because-obvious`, `--decorative-assertion-suffices`, `--refactor-without-safety-net` flag.
**§11.4.244 — Cross-boundary contract tests + can-i-deploy gate (research-derived, 2026-08-15).** Compact summary: changes modifying a boundary between independently-deployable components (service↔consumer, library↔dependents, DB schema↔readers/writers, message topic↔subscribers) MUST be covered by CONSUMER-DRIVEN CONTRACT TESTS on both sides AND a `can-i-deploy` gate MUST verify proposed provider version compatibility against every currently-deployed consumer version (and vice versa) BEFORE the change ships. CDC pattern: consumers publish assumptions they make about the provider (Pact / Spring Cloud Contract / gRPC schema-evolution); providers verify each consumer's contract against actual implementation; provider change breaking a live consumer's contract fails provider's build. CAN-I-DEPLOY: at deploy attempt, gate queries broker for compatibility matrix (P × C1 × C2 × C3); single red cell BLOCKS deploy naming incompatible pair, NEVER warning-with-continue; MISSING contract = first-class refusal reason (§11.4.201, not implicit "assume compatible"). SemVer becomes MEASURABLE: PATCH bump breaking contract = mis-labelled version. Backward-compatibility window declared per §11.4.35 (support current + previous N minor versions, deprecate with M weeks notice); consumers outside window flagged for §11.4.66 operator decision. §11.4.244 MERGES what the task brief labelled contract-tests + can-i-deploy — they are useless in isolation. Composes §11.4.5 / §11.4.6 / §11.4.35 / §11.4.66 / §11.4.108 (per-side four-layer) / §11.4.135 (contract tests as permanent regression guards) / §11.4.185 (composed-system manual QA still needed) / §11.4.201 (gate honesty). Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-244-PROPAGATION` + recommended gates `CM-CONTRACT-TESTS-BOTH-SIDES` + `CM-CAN-I-DEPLOY-GATE-WIRED` + paired §1.1 mutations. **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.244. Non-compliance is a release blocker. No escape hatch — no `--skip-contract-tests`, `--deploy-without-compatibility-check`, `--assume-compatible-when-broker-silent`, `--patch-may-break-contract`, `--contract-tests-optional-for-internal-boundaries` flag.

**§11.4.245 — Oracle-problem-first test authoring: identify the oracle BEFORE authoring the test (research-derived, 2026-08-15).** Compact summary: every test MUST FIRST identify its ORACLE — the mechanism deciding PASS vs FAIL for the input it drives — and the oracle MUST be DIFFERENT from the code under test AND from the test's own assertion mechanism. Authoring without explicit oracle identification produces the "test agrees with code" anti-pattern (test asserts what code happens to produce, so it passes as long as code produces something, never catches wrong-output). ORACLE STRATEGY CLOSED SET, each test's oracle NAMED in source (comment/docstring/tag): (1) SPECIFIED (spec/RFC/standard names expected output), (2) DERIVED (independent reference implementation), (3) METAMORPHIC (metamorphic relations between related inputs), (4) GOLDEN-MASTER / CHARACTERIZATION (past captured behavior — §11.4.243), (5) INVARIANT (universal property — sort output sorted + permutation of input; serialize-deserialize round-trip = original), (6) STATISTICAL (distribution properties for stochastic outputs, never specific value), (7) HUMAN (§11.4.185 manual QA). NO other classes. STRUCTURAL INDEPENDENCE: oracle's SOURCE of expected value must not depend on code being tested — different implementation / spec / previous run / mathematical property / inverse operation / human. Reviewer per §11.4.194 verifies (i) NAMED strategy, (ii) structural independence, (iii) paired §1.1 mutation flips the oracle. Composes §11.4.5 / §11.4.6 / §11.4.107(10) (self-validated analyzers — analyzer-as-oracle) / §11.4.115 / §11.4.194 / §11.4.201 / §11.4.224 / §11.4.243. Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-245-PROPAGATION` + recommended gate `CM-ORACLE-STRATEGY-NAMED-AND-INDEPENDENT` + paired §1.1 mutation. **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.245. Non-compliance is a release blocker. No escape hatch — no `--test-agrees-with-code`, `--skip-oracle-identification`, `--oracle-is-the-code`, `--assertion-is-oracle`, `--implicit-oracle-OK` flag.

ORACLE STRATEGY CLOSED SET, each test's oracle NAMED in source (comment/docstring/tag): (1) SPECIFIED (spec/RFC/standard names expected output), (2) DERIVED (independent reference implementation), (3) METAMORPHIC (metamorphic relations between related inputs), (4) GOLDEN-MASTER / CHARACTERIZATION (past captured behavior — §11.4.243), (5) INVARIANT (universal property — sort output sorted + permutation of input; serialize-deserialize round-trip = original), (6) STATISTICAL (distribution properties for stochastic outputs, never specific value), (7) HUMAN (§11.4.185 manual QA). NO other classes. STRUCTURAL INDEPENDENCE: oracle's SOURCE of expected value must not depend on code being tested — different implementation / spec / previous run / mathematical property / inverse operation / human. Reviewer per §11.4.194 verifies (i) NAMED strategy, (ii) structural independence, (iii) paired §1.1 mutation flips the oracle. Composes §11.4.5 / §11.4.6 / §11.4.107(10) (self-validated analyzers — analyzer-as-oracle) / §11.4.115 / §11.4.194 / §11.4.201 / §11.4.224 / §11.4.243. Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-245-PROPAGATION` + recommended gate `CM-ORACLE-STRATEGY-NAMED-AND-INDEPENDENT` + paired §1.1 mutation. **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.245. Non-compliance is a release blocker. No escape hatch — no `--test-agrees-with-code`, `--skip-oracle-identification`, `--oracle-is-the-code`, `--assertion-is-oracle`, `--implicit-oracle-OK` flag.

**§11.4.246 — Reproducible + hermetic builds + supply-chain integrity at SLSA Build Level 2 as fleet-wide minimum (operator decision, 2026-08-15).** Compact summary: every consuming project's build pipeline MUST produce REPRODUCIBLE + HERMETIC artifacts and meet SLSA Build Level 2 as fleet-wide MINIMUM (operator decision 2026-08-15 — L3+ tracked as backlog per §11.4.197). REPRODUCIBLE = same source at same time on any conformant host produces byte-identical artifacts (or diff-set fully accounted for by declared non-determinisms pinned to canonical values). HERMETIC = no undeclared inputs (every dep version-pinned + lockfile-hashed, every tool version declared, no unpinned public-network reach at build, no host-env leakage). SLSA-L2 = signed provenance describing source URI + commit hash + builder identity + invocation + artifact hash, on hosted tamper-resistant build platform (boba already satisfies ancillary: SSH-only §2.1, rootless podman §11.4.161, fixed-tag pins §11.4.30/§11.4.77). Every consumer MAINTAINS `docs/security/SLSA_LEVEL.md` (or equivalent per §11.4.35) recording CURRENT L level with cited evidence + TARGET L + tracked §11.4.197 upgrade items — CURRENT below L2 without tracked item is violation. SUPPLY-CHAIN EXTENSION: deps either vendored (checked in hash-verified), from provenance-attested source (npm/PyPI/crates.io as they add SLSA), OR mirrored through hash-pinning local registry — an unattested public source is integrity risk. Threat model NARROW: covers source→artifact chain, does NOT cover malicious commit landing in source (§11.4.142 review) nor compromised dep source (supply-chain extension) nor bug-free artifact (§11.4.108 four-layer + §11.4.185 manual QA). Composes §2.1 / §11.4.6 / §11.4.30 / §11.4.35 / §11.4.108 / §11.4.113 / §11.4.135 / §11.4.142 / §11.4.161 / §11.4.184 / §11.4.185 / §11.4.197 / §11.4.209. Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-246-PROPAGATION` + recommended gates `CM-BUILD-REPRODUCIBILITY` + `CM-BUILD-HERMETICITY` + `CM-SLSA-L2-PROVENANCE-VERIFIED` + `CM-SUPPLY-CHAIN-DEPS-PROVENANCE-ATTESTED` + paired §1.1 mutations. **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.246. Non-compliance is a release blocker. No escape hatch — no `--skip-reproducibility`, `--allow-network-during-build`, `--no-provenance`, `--slsa-optional`, `--below-l2-OK`, `--unpinned-dependency-OK`, `--host-env-may-leak-into-build` flag.

REPRODUCIBLE = same source at same time on any conformant host produces byte-identical artifacts (or diff-set fully accounted for by declared non-determinisms pinned to canonical values). HERMETIC = no undeclared inputs (every dep version-pinned + lockfile-hashed, every tool version declared, no unpinned public-network reach at build, no host-env leakage). SLSA-L2 = signed provenance describing source URI + commit hash + builder identity + invocation + artifact hash, on hosted tamper-resistant build platform (boba already satisfies ancillary: SSH-only §2.1, rootless podman §11.4.161, fixed-tag pins §11.4.30/§11.4.77). Every consumer MAINTAINS `docs/security/SLSA_LEVEL.md` (or equivalent per §11.4.35) recording CURRENT L level with cited evidence + TARGET L + tracked §11.4.197 upgrade items — CURRENT below L2 without tracked item is violation. SUPPLY-CHAIN EXTENSION: deps either vendored (checked in hash-verified), from provenance-attested source (npm/PyPI/crates.io as they add SLSA), OR mirrored through hash-pinning local registry — an unattested public source is integrity risk. Threat model NARROW: covers source→artifact chain, does NOT cover malicious commit landing in source (§11.4.142 review) nor compromised dep source (supply-chain extension) nor bug-free artifact (§11.4.108 four-layer + §11.4.185 manual QA). **§11.4.248 — Flaky-test quarantine + protected-regression-spec gate via `[PROTECTED-SPEC: ATM-NNN]` tag + CODEOWNERS required reviewer (operator decision, 2026-08-15).** Compact summary: flaky tests are the SILENT ANTI-BLUFF DECAY vector (every flake conditions team to ignore red until real regression is dismissed as "probably flaky, re-run"). Two disciplines bound: (A) QUARANTINE — mechanical detection (test-history aggregator flags two-consecutive-run-different-verdict OR rerun-after-red pattern) moves flaky test to `tests/quarantine/` (per §11.4.35), opens tracked §11.4.197 stabilisation deadline, blocking suite runs WITHOUT quarantined test so green means green; deadline past = §11.4.66 extension or violation; (B) PROTECTED-REGRESSION-SPEC — regression tests codifying known-broken defect fixes (per §11.4.135 permanent-guard suite) MAY be tagged `# [PROTECTED-SPEC: ATM-NNN]` (target-language comment equivalent) referencing the workable-item ATM-NNN (§11.4.54) they guard, marking test as load-bearing regression guard whose modification requires elevated review. Tag applied deliberately per test (not blanket — that voids the discipline). CODEOWNERS-REQUIRED-REVIEWER GATE: consuming project's CODEOWNERS declares modifications to `[PROTECTED-SPEC]`-tagged tests OR `regression/**/*` path scope require designated required-reviewer approval BEFORE merge; composes with §2.1 SSH + §11.4.113 no-force-push (gate cannot be silently bypassed); audit trail in PR review thread + commit history. Gate CATCHES change so reviewer distinguishes STRENGTHEN (approve) vs FIX-DEFECT-IN-TEST (approve after verifying ATM-NNN's defect not silently re-introduced) vs WEAKEN/REMOVE (refuse or §11.4.66 escalate) — makes modification VISIBLE not preventable. Composes §2.1 / §11.4.6 / §11.4.35 / §11.4.50 (ideal empty quarantine) / §11.4.54 / §11.4.66 / §11.4.113 / §11.4.115 / §11.4.135 / §11.4.197 / §11.4.226. Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-248-PROPAGATION` + recommended gates `CM-FLAKY-TEST-QUARANTINE-WIRED` + `CM-PROTECTED-REGRESSION-SPEC-GATE` + paired §1.1 mutations. **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.248. Non-compliance is a release blocker. No escape hatch — no `--rerun-until-green`, `--quarantine-permanent`, `--protected-spec-review-optional`, `--codeowners-skip`, `--blanket-protect-everything`, `--tag-without-atm-id` flag.

**§11.4.249 — Producer ≠ oracle ≠ gate ≠ verifier + flight recorder (research-derived, 2026-08-15).** Compact summary: every load-bearing quality mechanism has FOUR distinct roles that MUST be structurally separate — (1) PRODUCER (code computing/emitting/building output), (2) ORACLE (mechanism deciding correctness per §11.4.245), (3) GATE (seam consuming oracle verdict to allow/block/proceed), (4) VERIFIER (mechanism auditing gate's decision — paired §1.1 mutation proving gate can refuse a bad output). Collapsing any two produces specific bluff class: producer=oracle (§11.4.245 oracle-agrees-with-code); oracle=gate (refuses to say "cannot decide" defaults to allow, §11.4.201(6) FALSE-NULL); gate=verifier (self-auditing gate — §11.4.142 self-review anti-pattern applied). FLIGHT RECORDER: mechanism CAPTURING producer inputs + oracle verdict + gate decision + verifier audit as durable replayable artifact (structured JSONL event stream per §11.4.116, content-addressed per §11.4.207) so post-hoc "why did this go through" has evidence not shrug. Recorder is NOT the gate — a gate reading its own recorder to decide collapses gate + verifier + recorder. DETECTABLE COLLAPSES reviewer per §11.4.194 scans for: (1) producer=oracle (test's assertion calls code being tested), (2) oracle=gate (no "cannot decide" branch, defaults PASS), (3) gate=verifier (meta-test IS the gate — mutation making gate always-pass ALSO makes meta-test always-pass; meta-test MUST live OUTSIDE gate), (4) recorder=decision-substrate (gate uses recorder contents as decision input — precedent-based gating not authorised). Composes §11.4.5 / §11.4.6 / §11.4.107(10) / §11.4.116 / §11.4.142 / §11.4.194 / §11.4.201 / §11.4.207 / §11.4.240 (producer↔verifier separation principle — the WHY behind this four-role architecture) / §11.4.245. Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-249-PROPAGATION` + recommended gates `CM-ROLE-SEPARATION-DECLARED` + `CM-FLIGHT-RECORDER-CAPTURED` + paired §1.1 mutations. **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.249. Non-compliance is a release blocker. No escape hatch — no `--collapse-producer-oracle`, `--gate-self-audits`, `--skip-flight-recorder`, `--oracle-defaults-pass`, `--decision-without-recorded-rationale` flag.

**§11.4.249 — Producer ≠ oracle ≠ gate ≠ verifier + flight recorder (research-derived, 2026-08-15).** Compact summary: every load-bearing quality mechanism has FOUR distinct roles that MUST be structurally separate — (1) PRODUCER (code computing/emitting/building output), (2) ORACLE (mechanism deciding correctness per §11.4.245), (3) GATE (seam consuming oracle verdict to allow/block/proceed), (4) VERIFIER (mechanism auditing gate's decision — paired §1.1 mutation proving gate can refuse a bad output). Collapsing any two produces specific bluff class: producer=oracle (§11.4.245 oracle-agrees-with-code); oracle=gate (refuses to say "cannot decide" defaults to allow, §11.4.201(6) FALSE-NULL); gate=verifier (self-auditing gate — §11.4.142 self-review anti-pattern applied). FLIGHT RECORDER: mechanism CAPTURING producer inputs + oracle verdict + gate decision + verifier audit as durable replayable artifact (structured JSONL event stream per §11.4.116, content-addressed per §11.4.207) so post-hoc "why did this go through" has evidence not shrug. Recorder is NOT the gate — a gate reading its own recorder to decide collapses gate + verifier + recorder. DETECTABLE COLLAPSES reviewer per §11.4.194 scans for: (1) producer=oracle (test's assertion calls code being tested), (2) oracle=gate (no "cannot decide" branch, defaults PASS), (3) gate=verifier (meta-test IS the gate — mutation making gate always-pass ALSO makes meta-test always-pass; meta-test MUST live OUTSIDE gate), (4) recorder=decision-substrate (gate uses recorder contents as decision input — precedent-based gating not authorised). Composes §11.4.5 / §11.4.6 / §11.4.107(10) / §11.4.116 / §11.4.142 / §11.4.194 / §11.4.201 / §11.4.207 / §11.4.240 (producer↔verifier separation principle — the WHY behind this four-role architecture) / §11.4.245. Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-249-PROPAGATION` + recommended gates `CM-ROLE-SEPARATION-DECLARED` + `CM-FLIGHT-RECORDER-CAPTURED` + paired §1.1 mutations. **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.249. Non-compliance is a release blocker. No escape hatch — no `--collapse-producer-oracle`, `--gate-self-audits`, `--skip-flight-recorder`, `--oracle-defaults-pass`, `--decision-without-recorded-rationale` flag.

**§11.4.250 — Heuristic-tower signals a primitive defect: when N heuristic layers stack to compensate, the primitive is broken (research-derived, 2026-08-15).** Compact summary: codebase accumulating TOWER of heuristics compensating for same underlying issue (retry-with-backoff + connection-pool-warmup + DNS-cache-flush + health-check-with-startup-grace — all guarding one flaky DB connection) IS the diagnostic: PRIMITIVE is defective, every layer papers over a manifestation without fixing cause. Recognition signals: (i) each layer justification "we added because sometimes X happens" — reactive, (ii) removing any layer INCREASES failures BUT keeping all shows occasional residual, (iii) no single layer owns responsibility, (iv) layers added at different times by different authors per specific incidents, (v) monotone layer-count growth over time — debugging session for residual adds layer N+1 rather than fixing 1..N. DISTINCT from defense-in-depth: defense-in-depth is deliberate + each layer targets DIFFERENT failure class + designed together not accreted + removing layer produces SPECIFIC different failure not "same failure more often". SYSTEMATIC-DEBUGGING RESPONSE on tower depth ≥ 2: (1) STOP adding layers, (2) INVOKE §11.4.102 systematic-debugging on PRIMITIVE, (3) proceed root-cause / pattern / hypothesis / implementation phases, (4) fix primitive, (5) REMOVE layers one at a time verifying with §11.4.5 evidence, (6) commit each removal per §11.4.124 with git-history evidence citing primitive fix. Composes §11.4.5 / §11.4.6 / §11.4.102 / §11.4.124 / §11.4.194 / §11.4.201 (outer layer masks §11.4.201(6) false-null) / §11.4.226. Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-250-PROPAGATION` + recommended gate `CM-HEURISTIC-TOWER-TRIGGERS-PRIMITIVE-DEBUG` + paired §1.1 mutation. **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.250. Non-compliance is a release blocker. No escape hatch — no `--add-another-heuristic-layer`, `--skip-primitive-debug`, `--tower-is-defense-in-depth-without-justification`, `--reactive-mitigation-OK`, `--layer-per-incident` flag.

**§11.4.251 — Byte-identical-fork prohibition + role-as-data-pack (research-derived, 2026-08-15).** Compact summary: when project needs would be met by TWO NEAR-IDENTICAL CODE COPIES differing only in configuration / data / role-specific parameters (prod + staging with hardcoded hostnames; reader + writer with different flag values; web + mobile with different feature flags), copies MUST NOT be maintained as parallel forks. Instead ONE code copy retained + role-specific values extracted into DATA PACK (role-config file / env var set / capability descriptor / feature-flag bundle) consumed by the one code to instantiate as either role. Anti-pattern: FORK-AND-DIVERGE (copies drift as one patched not other, until drift = defect surface no one owns). DETECTION: reviewer or mechanical scan finds byte-identical fork when `diff` shows every difference is a config value (hostname/port/flag/label/env/credential-ref) NOT behavioral, common git-history ancestor, > 90% byte identity; per §11.4.35 threshold-DATA. EXTRACTION: (1) IDENTIFY configuration surface (closed value set differing), (2) EXTRACT to data pack per role, (3) REFACTOR single code copy to consume at instantiation (constructor injection / factory / config-loader-at-startup), (4) DELETE one fork, (5) VERIFY per §11.4.5 both role instantiations produce same observable behavior their forks previously produced (§11.4.243 characterization before refactor), (6) commit extraction per §11.4.124 with git-history evidence. LEGITIMATE FORKS: temporary migration (tracked §11.4.197 end date), experimental / A-B (bounded end date), truly divergent behavior (copies differ in algorithm/protocol/data-model not just config). Composes §11.4.5 / §11.4.6 / §11.4.28 (decoupling — role-configurable code shared across consumers) / §11.4.35 (data-pack location) / §11.4.124 / §11.4.177 / §11.4.194 / §11.4.197 / §11.4.243. Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-251-PROPAGATION` + recommended gate `CM-NO-BYTE-IDENTICAL-FORK` + paired §1.1 mutation. **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.251. Non-compliance is a release blocker. No escape hatch — no `--fork-for-role-OK`, `--skip-data-pack-extraction`, `--copy-and-modify-config`, `--duplicate-code-per-environment`, `--near-identical-forks-are-fine` flag.

**§11.4.252 — Fail-closed-on-dangerous-combination for mutating/credential surfaces (research-derived, 2026-08-15).** Compact summary: every code path COMBINING ≥ 2 dangerous capabilities MUST FAIL CLOSED — refuse operation unless every capability's precondition verifiably satisfied — NEVER fail open on ambiguous/missing/unresolvable input. Security-engineering generalisation of §11.4.201 guard-honesty applied to code paths where false-negative blast radius dwarfs operator inconvenience of false-positive. DANGEROUS-COMBINATION TAXONOMY: (1) MUTATION of shared resource (DB / filesystem / container state / config), (2) UNTRUSTED INPUT (user string / network bytes / external env var / unverified file), (3) CREDENTIAL ACCESS (secret read / authenticated API call / signing key use), (4) EXTERNAL SIDE EFFECT (email / webhook / MQ publish / payment endpoint), (5) SHELL / EXEC (subshell / binary with user-influenced args / template eval with user values), (6) IRREVERSIBLE (delete / drop / truncate — §11.4.113 force-push already absolutely forbidden). Any path combining ≥ 2 = dangerous-combination, MUST fail closed. INVARIANT: (1) VERIFY every precondition (authorization + input shape + credential presence + target identity), (2) REFUSE when ANY unverifiable with ERROR EXIT naming specific unresolved precondition, (3) EMIT captured evidence per §11.4.5 of refusal (log reason + resolved inputs + unresolved precondition + caller identity), (4) NEVER default to allow/proceed/retry-with-relaxed on ambiguity — §11.4.101 conservative-safe default = REFUSE. FAIL-OPEN ANTI-PATTERNS refused: `catch { /* ignore */ }`, `credential = credential || default`, `if (!valid) { log("warn"); return proceed(input); }`, `target = user_input || default_target`, unbounded `retry { dangerous(); }`. Distinct from graceful degradation (cache-miss returning cache-miss response is legitimate — NOT dangerous combination). Composes §11.4.5 / §11.4.6 / §11.4.10 (credentials specialisation) / §11.4.66 (operator escalation when refuse stuck) / §11.4.101 / §11.4.113 (max instantiation) / §11.4.194 / §11.4.201. Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-252-PROPAGATION` + recommended gate `CM-DANGEROUS-COMBINATION-FAIL-CLOSED` + paired §1.1 mutation. **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.252. Non-compliance is a release blocker. No escape hatch — no `--fail-open-on-error`, `--swallow-exception`, `--default-missing-credential`, `--proceed-on-ambiguous-input`, `--retry-until-succeeds` flag.

Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Non-compliance is a release blocker. No escape hatch — no `--fail-open-on-error`, `--swallow-exception`, `--default-missing-credential`, `--proceed-on-ambiguous-input`, `--retry-until-succeeds` flag.
**§11.4.252 — Fail-closed-on-dangerous-combination for mutating/credential surfaces (research-derived, 2026-08-15).** Compact summary: every code path COMBINING ≥ 2 dangerous capabilities MUST FAIL CLOSED — refuse operation unless every capability's precondition verifiably satisfied — NEVER fail open on ambiguous/missing/unresolvable input. Security-engineering generalisation of §11.4.201 guard-honesty applied to code paths where false-negative blast radius dwarfs operator inconvenience of false-positive. DANGEROUS-COMBINATION TAXONOMY: (1) MUTATION of shared resource (DB / filesystem / container state / config), (2) UNTRUSTED INPUT (user string / network bytes / external env var / unverified file), (3) CREDENTIAL ACCESS (secret read / authenticated API call / signing key use), (4) EXTERNAL SIDE EFFECT (email / webhook / MQ publish / payment endpoint), (5) SHELL / EXEC (subshell / binary with user-influenced args / template eval with user values), (6) IRREVERSIBLE (delete / drop / truncate — §11.4.113 force-push already absolutely forbidden). Any path combining ≥ 2 = dangerous-combination, MUST fail closed. INVARIANT: (1) VERIFY every precondition (authorization + input shape + credential presence + target identity), (2) REFUSE when ANY unverifiable with ERROR EXIT naming specific unresolved precondition, (3) EMIT captured evidence per §11.4.5 of refusal (log reason + resolved inputs + unresolved precondition + caller identity), (4) NEVER default to allow/proceed/retry-with-relaxed on ambiguity — §11.4.101 conservative-safe default = REFUSE. FAIL-OPEN ANTI-PATTERNS refused: `catch { /* ignore */ }`, `credential = credential || default`, `if (!valid) { log("warn"); return proceed(input); }`, `target = user_input || default_target`, unbounded `retry { dangerous(); }`. Distinct from graceful degradation (cache-miss returning cache-miss response is legitimate — NOT dangerous combination). Composes §11.4.5 / §11.4.6 / §11.4.10 (credentials specialisation) / §11.4.66 (operator escalation when refuse stuck) / §11.4.101 / §11.4.113 (max instantiation) / §11.4.194 / §11.4.201. Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-252-PROPAGATION` + recommended gate `CM-DANGEROUS-COMBINATION-FAIL-CLOSED` + paired §1.1 mutation. **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.252. **§11.4.253 — Idempotency under retry + DB-level durable uniqueness guard (research-derived, 2026-08-15).** Compact summary: every retryable operation (network calls with auto-retry, at-least-once MQ consumers, cron with overlapping schedules, HTTP endpoints with client-retry, DB transactions with retry-on-serialisation-failure, deploy pipelines with rerun capability) MUST BE IDEMPOTENT: N executions produce same observable end state as one. Idempotency ENFORCED at LOWEST LAYER where "same end state" is durably provable — typically DATABASE UNIQUENESS CONSTRAINT on caller-supplied idempotency key, NEVER only application-layer check-then-insert (races). Prevents DOUBLE-CHARGE / DOUBLE-EMAIL / DOUBLE-DELETE / DOUBLE-EFFECT bugs. IDEMPOTENCY-KEY DISCIPLINE: every retryable op accepts (or generates + passes forward) unique identifier naming THIS logical op; persistence layer has UNIQUE INDEX / CONSTRAINT on key column; second attempt REFUSED by DB at durable level not application logic reading-then-writing; refusal caught by caller as "duplicate — already succeeded" = SUCCESS (op happened, no further retry). ANTI-PATTERNS: (i) check-then-insert without unique index races, (ii) app-level dedup table read without spanning-transaction, (iii) key scoped to app instance (in-memory not shared), (iv) effect persisted BEFORE key (crash between = double-effect on retry), (v) no key at all + "the effect is 'set X to V' so redoing is fine" (safe for pure sets, NOT for INSERTs / MQ emissions / external-system side effects), (vi) idempotency-key expires — converts to time-bounded-idempotent = §11.4.6 mis-labelling if caller expects unbounded. CHAOS VERIFICATION per §11.4.85: (1) SIMULTANEOUS RETRIES (same key from 2 concurrent callers), (2) MID-OPERATION CRASHES (kill receiver between "check exists" and "insert effect"), (3) RETRY AFTER APPARENT SUCCESS (caller believes fail, receiver persisted, retry MUST recognise duplicate). External-system side effects (Stripe/PayPal charging card + local DB write): idempotency key MUST pass through to external; if external does not support, op is not fully idempotent — label honestly per §11.4.6. Composes §11.4.5 / §11.4.6 / §11.4.85 / §11.4.201 / §11.4.252. Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-253-PROPAGATION` + recommended gates `CM-IDEMPOTENCY-DB-LEVEL-UNIQUE-GUARD` + `CM-IDEMPOTENCY-CHAOS-VERIFIED` + paired §1.1 mutation. **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.253. Non-compliance is a release blocker. No escape hatch — no `--check-then-insert-OK`, `--application-dedup-suffices`, `--skip-idempotency-chaos-test`, `--claim-idempotent-without-key`, `--expire-idempotency-marker-silently` flag.

No escape hatch — no `--check-then-insert-OK`, `--application-dedup-suffices`, `--skip-idempotency-chaos-test`, `--claim-idempotent-without-key`, `--expire-idempotency-marker-silently` flag.
**§11.4.253 — Idempotency under retry + DB-level durable uniqueness guard (research-derived, 2026-08-15).** Compact summary: every retryable operation (network calls with auto-retry, at-least-once MQ consumers, cron with overlapping schedules, HTTP endpoints with client-retry, DB transactions with retry-on-serialisation-failure, deploy pipelines with rerun capability) MUST BE IDEMPOTENT: N executions produce same observable end state as one. Idempotency ENFORCED at LOWEST LAYER where "same end state" is durably provable — typically DATABASE UNIQUENESS CONSTRAINT on caller-supplied idempotency key, NEVER only application-layer check-then-insert (races). Prevents DOUBLE-CHARGE / DOUBLE-EMAIL / DOUBLE-DELETE / DOUBLE-EFFECT bugs. IDEMPOTENCY-KEY DISCIPLINE: every retryable op accepts (or generates + passes forward) unique identifier naming THIS logical op; persistence layer has UNIQUE INDEX / CONSTRAINT on key column; second attempt REFUSED by DB at durable level not application logic reading-then-writing; refusal caught by caller as "duplicate — already succeeded" = SUCCESS (op happened, no further retry). ANTI-PATTERNS: (i) check-then-insert without unique index races, (ii) app-level dedup table read without spanning-transaction, (iii) key scoped to app instance (in-memory not shared), (iv) effect persisted BEFORE key (crash between = double-effect on retry), (v) no key at all + "the effect is 'set X to V' so redoing is fine" (safe for pure sets, NOT for INSERTs / MQ emissions / external-system side effects), (vi) idempotency-key expires — converts to time-bounded-idempotent = §11.4.6 mis-labelling if caller expects unbounded. CHAOS VERIFICATION per §11.4.85: (1) SIMULTANEOUS RETRIES (same key from 2 concurrent callers), (2) MID-OPERATION CRASHES (kill receiver between "check exists" and "insert effect"), (3) RETRY AFTER APPARENT SUCCESS (caller believes fail, receiver persisted, retry MUST recognise duplicate). External-system side effects (Stripe/PayPal charging card + local DB write): idempotency key MUST pass through to external; if external does not support, op is not fully idempotent — label honestly per §11.4.6. Composes §11.4.5 / §11.4.6 / §11.4.85 / §11.4.201 / §11.4.252. Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-253-PROPAGATION` + recommended gates `CM-IDEMPOTENCY-DB-LEVEL-UNIQUE-GUARD` + `CM-IDEMPOTENCY-CHAOS-VERIFIED` + paired §1.1 mutation. **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.253. Non-compliance is a release blocker. No escape hatch — no `--check-then-insert-OK`, `--application-dedup-suffices`, `--skip-idempotency-chaos-test`, `--claim-idempotent-without-key`, `--expire-idempotency-marker-silently` flag.
**§11.4.254 — Boot-time invariant assertion + capability matrix (research-derived, 2026-08-15).** Compact summary: every service / process / long-running executable MUST assert BOOT-TIME INVARIANTS at startup — required env vars present + valid; required config files parseable + declared schema version matches; required deps reachable; required credentials present + not-expired; required schema migrations applied; required feature-flag states declared; required host resources present (disk / memory / thread limits per §12.12 / port availability) — and FAIL FAST + LOUD if any violated, BEFORE accepting request / performing work. Prevents "service silently starts with broken invariant + serves requests that fail deep in request path hours after boot." INVARIANT CLASSES: (i) environment, (ii) configuration, (iii) dependencies, (iv) credentials, (v) schema, (vi) capabilities, (vii) host. FAIL-FAST-LOUD: (1) EMIT structured error to stderr + captured log naming specific failed invariant (env var name / config path / dep URL / credential file / schema version), (2) EXIT non-zero (traditionally 78 EX_CONFIG for config, consumer supplies per §11.4.35), (3) DO NOT accept requests / begin main event loop / bind listening port. Service booting partially + serving requests-that-will-fail is worse than refusing to start — partial-boot masquerades healthy long enough for load balancer to route traffic. Dual to §11.4.252 fail-closed on dangerous combinations: both refuse to proceed on unresolvable preconditions. CAPABILITY MATRIX: consumer's `docs/services/CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md` (per §11.4.35) declares per service (i) boot-time invariants, (ii) runtime capabilities OFFERED (endpoints / topics / callable functions), (iii) runtime capabilities REQUIRED from other services. Regenerated / verified on every commit per §11.4.106 docs-chain + §11.4.86 fingerprint. Undeclared endpoints emitted = violation; silent upstream deps not declared = violation (invisible to §11.4.244 contract testing). Composes §11.4.5 / §11.4.6 / §11.4.35 / §11.4.86 / §11.4.106 / §11.4.108 Layer 3 (boot IS runtime-on-clean-target check) / §11.4.128 / §11.4.244 (contract tests consume matrix) / §11.4.252 / §12.12. Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-254-PROPAGATION` + recommended gates `CM-BOOT-TIME-INVARIANT-ASSERTED` + `CM-CAPABILITY-MATRIX-PRESENT-AND-IN-SYNC` + paired §1.1 mutations. **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.254. **§11.4.255 — Mandatory HelixTranslate canonical translation pipeline (User mandate, 2026-06-25).** Compact summary: ALL translations of ANY content — UI strings, documents, articles, CVs, READMEs, marketing copy, in-app messages, release notes, legal text, ANY human-language string rendered in a non-source language — MUST be produced by **HelixTranslate** (`git@github.com:HelixDevelopment/HelixTranslate.git`) driven through the canonical universal translation pipeline shipped in the constitution submodule at `scripts/translation/` (`translate-pipeline.sh` + `render-articles.sh`) — a hard, non-negotiable constraint. FORBIDDEN as §11.4.255 violations: (a) **hand-translation** — no human-authored, manually edited, or "good enough" hand-written translation of any content, ever; the engine is the single source of every translated string; (b) **other engines** — no Google Translate, DeepL, raw ChatGPT/Claude prompting, OS translation APIs, library i18n auto-translators, or any engine other than HelixTranslate's `unified-translator`; there is exactly one engine; (c) **silent fallback** — no quiet substitution of the source string, no empty/partial output passed off as a translation, no swallowed engine error, no absence-of-error PASS (§11.4/§11.4.1); on exhaustion of all configured providers the pipeline MUST FAIL LOUD (non-zero exit, destination NOT written) so the caller detects it, a missing translation being a hard error never a degraded-but-shipped string — provider-to-provider failover WITHIN HelixTranslate (primary → fallback, with logged, evidenced retries) is NOT a silent fallback and is permitted, while falling back to ANY non-HelixTranslate source is forbidden. **Mandatory validation** — every generated translation MUST be validated for accuracy with real (physical) captured evidence per §11.4.5/§11.4.69/§11.4.107, no metadata-only / config-only / grep-without-runtime PASS (§11.4/§11.4.1), no false results, no bluff of any kind (§11.4.6); the per-file run log (provider used, byte counts, retries, success/failure) IS the evidence artifact, and an unvalidated or unevidenced translation is treated as ABSENT. **Explicit provider routing** — provider + model routing MUST be explicit and recorded, never implicit/defaulted-in-the-dark; the canonical routing is provider `groq` / model `llama-3.3-70b-versatile` with documented failover to provider `mistral` / model `mistral-large-latest`, the provider that actually produced each output MUST be recorded in the per-file log, and any deviation from the canonical routing MUST be stated explicitly in configuration and logged. **Canonical pipeline location** — `scripts/translation/translate-pipeline.sh` (universal Markdown / plain-text + article-frontmatter-preserving translator) + `scripts/translation/render-articles.sh` (article-source → HTML fragment renderer); both reusable verbatim across projects, the engine binary supplied by the consuming project via `HELIX_TRANSLATE_BIN` and built from the HelixTranslate repository. **Rationale** — a single, evidenced, fail-loud translation engine guarantees every translated string in the fleet has a known provenance, a reproducible pipeline, and a captured accuracy proof, eliminating the silent drift, inconsistent quality, and untraceable "where did this string come from" failures that hand-translation and ad-hoc engines produce: one engine, one pipeline, one evidence trail. Classification: universal (§11.4.17) — a platform-neutral, language-neutral translation discipline reusable by ANY project; the consuming project supplies its concrete source files, target languages, and the HelixTranslate engine build per §11.4.35. Composes §11.4 / §11.4.1 / §11.4.5 / §11.4.6 / §11.4.7 / §11.4.69 / §11.4.107. Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-255-PROPAGATION` (literal `11.4.255`) + recommended gate `CM-MANDATORY-HELIXTRANSLATE-PIPELINE` + paired §1.1 meta-test mutation (gate-code = separate work item). **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.255. Non-compliance is a release blocker regardless of context. No escape hatch — no `--allow-hand-translation`, `--other-engine-OK`, `--skip-translation-validation`, `--silent-fallback` flag exists.
**§11.4.255 — Mandatory HelixTranslate canonical translation pipeline (User mandate, 2026-06-25).** Compact summary: ALL translations of ANY content — UI strings, documents, articles, CVs, READMEs, marketing copy, in-app messages, release notes, legal text, ANY human-language string rendered in a non-source language — MUST be produced by **HelixTranslate** (`git@github.com:HelixDevelopment/HelixTranslate.git`) driven through the canonical universal translation pipeline shipped in the constitution submodule at `scripts/translation/` (`translate-pipeline.sh` + `render-articles.sh`) — a hard, non-negotiable constraint. FORBIDDEN as §11.4.255 violations: (a) **hand-translation** — no human-authored, manually edited, or "good enough" hand-written translation of any content, ever; the engine is the single source of every translated string; (b) **other engines** — no Google Translate, DeepL, raw ChatGPT/Claude prompting, OS translation APIs, library i18n auto-translators, or any engine other than HelixTranslate's `unified-translator`; there is exactly one engine; (c) **silent fallback** — no quiet substitution of the source string, no empty/partial output passed off as a translation, no swallowed engine error, no absence-of-error PASS (§11.4/§11.4.1); on exhaustion of all configured providers the pipeline MUST FAIL LOUD (non-zero exit, destination NOT written) so the caller detects it, a missing translation being a hard error never a degraded-but-shipped string — provider-to-provider failover WITHIN HelixTranslate (primary → fallback, with logged, evidenced retries) is NOT a silent fallback and is permitted, while falling back to ANY non-HelixTranslate source is forbidden. **Mandatory validation** — every generated translation MUST be validated for accuracy with real (physical) captured evidence per §11.4.5/§11.4.69/§11.4.107, no metadata-only / config-only / grep-without-runtime PASS (§11.4/§11.4.1), no false results, no bluff of any kind (§11.4.6); the per-file run log (provider used, byte counts, retries, success/failure) IS the evidence artifact, and an unvalidated or unevidenced translation is treated as ABSENT. **Explicit provider routing** — provider + model routing MUST be explicit and recorded, never implicit/defaulted-in-the-dark; the canonical routing is provider `groq` / model `llama-3.3-70b-versatile` with documented failover to provider `mistral` / model `mistral-large-latest`, the provider that actually produced each output MUST be recorded in the per-file log, and any deviation from the canonical routing MUST be stated explicitly in configuration and logged. **Canonical pipeline location** — `scripts/translation/translate-pipeline.sh` (universal Markdown / plain-text + article-frontmatter-preserving translator) + `scripts/translation/render-articles.sh` (article-source → HTML fragment renderer); both reusable verbatim across projects, the engine binary supplied by the consuming project via `HELIX_TRANSLATE_BIN` and built from the HelixTranslate repository. **Rationale** — a single, evidenced, fail-loud translation engine guarantees every translated string in the fleet has a known provenance, a reproducible pipeline, and a captured accuracy proof, eliminating the silent drift, inconsistent quality, and untraceable "where did this string come from" failures that hand-translation and ad-hoc engines produce: one engine, one pipeline, one evidence trail. Classification: universal (§11.4.17) — a platform-neutral, language-neutral translation discipline reusable by ANY project; the consuming project supplies its concrete source files, target languages, and the HelixTranslate engine build per §11.4.35. Composes §11.4 / §11.4.1 / §11.4.5 / §11.4.6 / §11.4.7 / §11.4.69 / §11.4.107. Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-255-PROPAGATION` (literal `11.4.255`) + recommended gate `CM-MANDATORY-HELIXTRANSLATE-PIPELINE` + paired §1.1 meta-test mutation (gate-code = separate work item). **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.255. Non-compliance is a release blocker regardless of context. No escape hatch — no `--allow-hand-translation`, `--other-engine-OK`, `--skip-translation-validation`, `--silent-fallback` flag exists.

**§11.4.256 — Mandatory independent per-language translation review (User mandate, 2026-06-25).** Compact summary: every translated artifact produced under §11.4.255 MUST, BEFORE it is shipped / committed / deployed, be INDEPENDENTLY REVIEWED for quality by a per-language review agent — a hard, non-negotiable gate that composes with, and NEVER replaces, the §11.4.255 generation mandate. Requirements: (a) **Independence** — the reviewer MUST be a different model/provider than the one that produced the translation (e.g. translator `mistral/mistral-large-latest` → reviewer `groq/llama-3.3-70b-versatile`, or any distinct verified model); a model reviewing its own output is NOT an independent review and is forbidden. (b) **Per-language specialization** — the reviewer MUST act as a NATIVE speaker / linguistic reviewer of the SPECIFIC target language, evaluating that language's grammar, orthography, and correct script (Cyrillic for ru/be/kk, Arabic for ar/fa, Han/Kana/Hangul/Devanagari for zh/ja/ko/hi, Latin for sr/de/es/fr/tr, etc.). (c) **Full criteria** — each review MUST judge accuracy/fidelity, fluency/naturalness, completeness (nothing omitted or invented), correct script + orthography, and absence of untranslated source leftovers (proper nouns / URLs / code excepted). (d) **Strict machine-readable verdict + evidence** — each review MUST emit a structured PASS/FAIL verdict with per-criterion scores and an issues list, persisted as a physical evidence artifact (§11.4.5 / §11.4.69 / §11.4.107); a FAIL — or an ERROR / unavailable-reviewer — BLOCKS the content and only a real PASS may ship, with no metadata-only / absence-of-error PASS (§11.4 / §11.4.1) and no bluff (§11.4.6). (e) **Remediation loop** — a FAIL routes the artifact back through the §11.4.255 pipeline (re-translate / multipass-polish) and is re-reviewed, iterating until PASS, NEVER hand-patched to pass (hand-translation remains forbidden under §11.4.255). **Canonical tooling** — `scripts/translation/review-translations.sh` (per-language review driver) + `scripts/translation/review_translation.py` (independent reviewer engine emitting strict JSON verdicts); reusable verbatim across projects, the consuming project supplying its source/translation file pairs and a reviewer provider DISTINCT from its translator. **Rationale** — §11.4.255 guarantees a translation's provenance and a fail-loud pipeline, but not its linguistic quality; an independent, native-level, per-language reviewer with a captured PASS/FAIL verdict is what turns "a string was produced" into "a string was verified correct", making translation quality an auditable fact rather than an assumption. Classification: universal (§11.4.17) — a platform-neutral, language-neutral translation-quality-assurance discipline reusable by ANY project that ships translated content. Composes §11.4.255 (the translation it gates) / §11.4 / §11.4.1 / §11.4.5 / §11.4.6 / §11.4.69 / §11.4.107 / §11.4.134 (rock-solid evidence). Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-256-PROPAGATION` (literal `11.4.256`) + recommended gate `CM-MANDATORY-TRANSLATION-REVIEW` + paired §1.1 meta-test mutation (gate-code = separate work item). **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.256. Non-compliance is a release blocker regardless of context. No escape hatch — no `--skip-translation-review`, `--self-review-OK`, `--accept-unreviewed-translation` flag exists.

**§11.4.257 — Comprehensive user-manual + guide + FAQ coverage: every component / service / feature ships an operator-usable manual, task-oriented guide, and FAQ (BACKGROUND :: REMINDER :: IMPORTANT operator mandate, 2026-08-15).** Compact summary: every consuming project MUST cover the whole project (every component, service, subsystem, binary, container, plugin, feature, user-visible workflow) with three cooperating documentation classes — (a) complete USER MANUAL per component/service/product, (b) task-oriented GUIDES for every user-facing workflow, (c) properly-created FAQs derived from real operator/QA/end-user questions — always in sync (§11.4.44/§11.4.106), always exported (§11.4.65), always reachable from README (§11.4.212), always tracked when incomplete (§11.4.197); a capability that ships without its manual+guide+FAQ trio is a §11.4.257 violation of §11.4 PASS-bluff severity at the documentation layer. **§11.4.262 — Machine-created evidence at every gate: every claim of works/passes/verified cites captured machine-derived machine-verifiable evidence, no operator eyeballing, no narrative-only PASS (BACKGROUND :: REMINDER :: IMPORTANT operator mandate, 2026-08-15).** Compact summary: every claim by the System that something WORKS / PASSES / IS VERIFIED / IS PRODUCTION-READY MUST cite MACHINE-CREATED + MACHINE-VERIFIABLE evidence produced by the gate itself, cited by path + sha256 + timestamp (§11.4.207 content-addressed); operator eyeballing / narrative-only PASS / "looks fine" / "no error" / prediction / guessing / assumption are FORBIDDEN (§11.4/§11.4.1/§11.4.6). STRENGTHENS the §11.4 covenant preamble from CAPTURED to CAPTURED-AND-MACHINE-VERIFIABLE evidence, applying §11.4.107(10) self-validating analyzers UNIVERSALLY (not only AV playback). THREE-GATE COVERAGE: (1) CONFIRMATION (source review + static + clash §11.4.110), (2) VALIDATION (§11.4.108 four layers each with its own machine verdict + artifact), (3) VERIFICATION (§11.4.185 human + §11.4.236 machine sufficiency, each with captured evidence). MACHINE-CREATED four properties: produced by the gate not the tester, schema-parseable/machine-verifiable (JSON verdict, JSONL event stream, OCR/vision oracle per §11.4.107/§11.4.117, audio RMS/loudness), content-addressed, semantic-class-matched (§11.4.226 wrong-layer echo forbidden). Every evidence analyzer golden-good/golden-bad/negative-control validated per §11.4.107(10); analyzer that passes its golden-bad = bluff itself + release-blocker (§11.4.201). Four-layer binding with §11.4.108 — every layer PASS cites machine evidence PRODUCED AT THAT LAYER; higher layer citing lower layer only = §11.4.226 wrong-layer violation. Standing default from first prompt (§11.4.126/§11.4.198). Honest boundary §11.4.6 — mandates evidence + analyzer validation; does not claim machine evidence proves human satisfaction (§11.4.185 remains); does not license shipping when machine evidence disagrees with reality (§11.4.238 escape). Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-262-PROPAGATION` + recommended gates `CM-MACHINE-EVIDENCE-AT-EVERY-GATE` / `CM-EVIDENCE-ANALYZER-SELF-VALIDATED` / `CM-NO-NARRATIVE-ONLY-PASS` / `CM-EVIDENCE-LAYER-MATCH-108` + paired §1.1 mutation. **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.262. **§11.4.262 — Machine-created evidence at every gate: every claim of works/passes/verified cites captured machine-derived machine-verifiable evidence, no operator eyeballing, no narrative-only PASS (BACKGROUND :: REMINDER :: IMPORTANT operator mandate, 2026-08-15).** Compact summary: every claim by the System that something WORKS / PASSES / IS VERIFIED / IS PRODUCTION-READY MUST cite MACHINE-CREATED + MACHINE-VERIFIABLE evidence produced by the gate itself, cited by path + sha256 + timestamp (§11.4.207 content-addressed); operator eyeballing / narrative-only PASS / "looks fine" / "no error" / prediction / guessing / assumption are FORBIDDEN (§11.4/§11.4.1/§11.4.6). STRENGTHENS the §11.4 covenant preamble from CAPTURED to CAPTURED-AND-MACHINE-VERIFIABLE evidence, applying §11.4.107(10) self-validating analyzers UNIVERSALLY (not only AV playback). THREE-GATE COVERAGE: (1) CONFIRMATION (source review + static + clash §11.4.110), (2) VALIDATION (§11.4.108 four layers each with its own machine verdict + artifact), (3) VERIFICATION (§11.4.185 human + §11.4.236 machine sufficiency, each with captured evidence). MACHINE-CREATED four properties: produced by the gate not the tester, schema-parseable/machine-verifiable (JSON verdict, JSONL event stream, OCR/vision oracle per §11.4.107/§11.4.117, audio RMS/loudness), content-addressed, semantic-class-matched (§11.4.226 wrong-layer echo forbidden). Every evidence analyzer golden-good/golden-bad/negative-control validated per §11.4.107(10); analyzer that passes its golden-bad = bluff itself + release-blocker (§11.4.201). Four-layer binding with §11.4.108 — every layer PASS cites machine evidence PRODUCED AT THAT LAYER; higher layer citing lower layer only = §11.4.226 wrong-layer violation. Standing default from first prompt (§11.4.126/§11.4.198). Honest boundary §11.4.6 — mandates evidence + analyzer validation; does not claim machine evidence proves human satisfaction (§11.4.185 remains); does not license shipping when machine evidence disagrees with reality (§11.4.238 escape). Classification: universal (§11.4.17).
