**§11.4.263 — Process-group signal-safety mandate: NEVER signal pgid ≤ 1, NEVER trust a mock-derived pid/pgid — validate as int > 1 before every killpg / kill(-pid, sig) / pkill / killall call (BOB-126 forensic anchor, 2026-08-19).** Compact summary: SEVEN forced-logout incidents on the operator's workstation over ~48h (BOB-116/120/123/124/125/126) traced by kernel audit trail to a single Python test — `AsyncMock().pid` unset → `MagicMock.__int__ == 1` default → `os.getpgid(1) == 1` → `os.killpg(1, SIGKILL)` → glibc → `kill(-1, SIGKILL)` = SIGKILL every UID-1000 process (systemd user@1000 manager, gnome-shell, tmux, ssh, browsers, Claude Code) — with `contextlib.suppress(Exception)` swallowing nothing because the syscall SUCCEEDED. Universal mandate: (A) NEVER signal `pgid ≤ 1` in any language — `killpg(1,sig)` == `kill(-1,sig)` == the disaster syscall on Linux/BSD/macOS; (B) validate `isinstance(pid,int) and pid > 1` AND `isinstance(pgid,int) and pgid > 1` before every process-group signal call (Python `os.killpg`, Go `syscall.Kill(-pgid,sig)`, Rust `nix killpg`, Bash `kill -<pgid>`/`pkill -g`, C `killpg`/`kill(-pid,sig)`); (C) TESTS mocking subprocess/proc objects MUST explicitly set `mock.pid = <int>` (never rely on mock library defaults) AND patch the killpg call itself AND assert killpg was called with `pgid > 1`; (D) DEFENSE-IN-DEPTH four-layer coverage per §11.4.4(b) — pre-build grep gate, post-build CodeGraph query, runtime kernel audit rule `syscall=kill a0=0xffffffff a1=9`, paired §1.1 mutation regression test; (E) honest boundary — hardens process-group signal APIs; does NOT prohibit legitimate `start_new_session=True` child-owned groups (guard still cheap); does NOT prevent kernel OOM-killer / systemd-oomd (§12.6 + §11.4.225 apply); (F) standing default from first prompt — every code review scans for killpg calls + verifies guard, every subagent writing subprocess-cleanup code includes the guard, every test-writing subagent includes explicit `mock.pid`. Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Composes §11.4.1/§11.4.4(b)/§11.4.5/§11.4.6/§11.4.85/§11.4.107(10)/§11.4.115/§11.4.126/§11.4.201/§11.4.225/§11.4.226. Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-263-PROPAGATION` + recommended gates `CM-KILLPG-PGID-GUARD` + `CM-TEST-MOCK-PID-EXPLICIT-INT` + paired §1.1 mutations. **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.263. Non-compliance is a release blocker regardless of context. No escape hatch — no `--skip-killpg-guard`, `--mock-pid-optional`, `--killpg-1-is-ok`, `--kill-minus-1-permitted`, `--suppress-catches-syscall`, `--test-may-not-explicit-pid` flag.

Universal mandate: (A) NEVER signal `pgid ≤ 1` in any language — `killpg(1,sig)` == `kill(-1,sig)` == the disaster syscall on Linux/BSD/macOS; (B) validate `isinstance(pid,int) and pid > 1` AND `isinstance(pgid,int) and pgid > 1` before every process-group signal call (Python `os.killpg`, Go `syscall.Kill(-pgid,sig)`, Rust `nix killpg`, Bash `kill -<pgid>`/`pkill -g`, C `killpg`/`kill(-pid,sig)`); (C) TESTS mocking subprocess/proc objects MUST explicitly set `mock.pid = <int>` (never rely on mock library defaults) AND patch the killpg call itself AND assert killpg was called with `pgid > 1`; (D) DEFENSE-IN-DEPTH four-layer coverage per §11.4.4(b) — pre-build grep gate, post-build CodeGraph query, runtime kernel audit rule `syscall=kill a0=0xffffffff a1=9`, paired §1.1 mutation regression test; (E) honest boundary — hardens process-group signal APIs; does NOT prohibit legitimate `start_new_session=True` child-owned groups (guard still cheap); does NOT prevent kernel OOM-killer / systemd-oomd (§12.6 + §11.4.225 apply); (F) standing default from first prompt — every code review scans for killpg calls + verifies guard, every subagent writing subprocess-cleanup code includes the guard, every test-writing subagent includes explicit `mock.pid`. Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Composes §11.4.1/§11.4.4(b)/§11.4.5/§11.4.6/§11.4.85/§11.4.107(10)/§11.4.115/§11.4.126/§11.4.201/§11.4.225/§11.4.226. Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-263-PROPAGATION` + recommended gates `CM-KILLPG-PGID-GUARD` + `CM-TEST-MOCK-PID-EXPLICIT-INT` + paired §1.1 mutations. **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.263. Non-compliance is a release blocker regardless of context. **§11.4.264 — Build once, promote ONE immutable content-addressed artifact through every environment; never rebuild per stage (research-derived, 2026-08-20).** Compact summary: exactly ONE artifact is produced per release candidate and THAT artifact is promoted through every environment; rebuilding per stage silently BREAKS THE CHAIN OF EVIDENCE, because every gate that ran against the staging artifact measured a DIFFERENT binary than production runs — making each of those green verdicts a §11.4 PASS-bluff about the shipped artifact (corpus module 31: *"The thing you tested must be the thing you ship … Rebuilding per environment silently breaks the chain of evidence"*; red flag: *"'We rebuild for production to be safe.'"*). (A) BUILD ONCE per release candidate under §11.4.246 (reproducible + hermetic + SLSA-L2); determinism makes a rebuild detectably equivalent, it is never a licence to rebuild instead of promote. (B) IDENTITY IS A CONTENT ADDRESS — a digest, never a mutable tag (*"tags get re-pushed; digests cannot change without changing the digest"*; the attack defended is *"the same version, different bytes"*), composing §11.4.111 and §11.4.200 (identity read BACK from the intended target). (C) PROMOTION IS A VERIFICATION — *"verify this exact digest is authentic and approved for the next environment," not "make a new thing and hope it's equivalent"*; signature/SBOM/provenance travel WITH the bytes. (D) ENVIRONMENT CONFIG IS INJECTED AT DEPLOY, NEVER BAKED AT BUILD (baking per-environment config re-creates the per-stage rebuild; §11.4.10 still forbids baking a secret). (E) ROLLBACK IS DETERMINISTIC BY CONSEQUENCE — point at the previous known-good digest, *"not a rebuild-from-source scramble under incident pressure"* — the precondition that makes §11.4.265's auto-abort a real undo. (F) REBUILD-TO-DODGE IS GATE-EVASION — *"re-running until green, or rebuilding to get a different result, launders a real failure into a pass"*; retries are counted and surfaced (§11.4.248). Honest boundary §11.4.6 — guarantees the tested bytes are the shipped bytes; does NOT prove them correct (§11.4.108/§11.4.40/§11.4.185), that the deploy reached the intended target (§11.4.200), or that injected config is right (§11.4.254). Classification: universal (§11.4.17); environment ladder, digest scheme and config-injection mechanism are consumer DATA per §11.4.35. Composes §11.4/.1/.6/.10/.35/.108/.111/.151/.200/.235(B)/.246 (its DEPLOY-side complement: §11.4.246 governs how the artifact is BUILT, §11.4.264 that it is not built AGAIN)/.248/.252/.265/§1.1. Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-264-PROPAGATION` (literal `11.4.264`) + recommended gates `CM-BUILD-ONCE-PROMOTE-DIGEST` + `CM-DEPLOY-CONFIG-INJECTED-NOT-BAKED` + paired §1.1 mutations (add a second per-environment build, or swap a promoted digest for a mutable tag, or bake an environment endpoint into the build → the gates FAIL; golden-FALSE per §11.4.201(1): one build + N digest-referencing promotions MUST NOT fire either); gate-code = separate work item, NOT claimed shipped (§11.4.6/§11.4.227). **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.264. Non-compliance is a release blocker. No escape hatch — no `--rebuild-per-environment`, `--promote-by-tag`, `--bake-env-config-at-build`, `--rebuild-until-green`, `--skip-digest-pin`, `--deterministic-build-means-rebuild-is-safe` flag.

(F) REBUILD-TO-DODGE IS GATE-EVASION — *"re-running until green, or rebuilding to get a different result, launders a real failure into a pass"*; retries are counted and surfaced (§11.4.248). Honest boundary §11.4.6 — guarantees the tested bytes are the shipped bytes; does NOT prove them correct (§11.4.108/§11.4.40/§11.4.185), that the deploy reached the intended target (§11.4.200), or that injected config is right (§11.4.254). Classification: universal (§11.4.17); environment ladder, digest scheme and config-injection mechanism are consumer DATA per §11.4.35. Composes §11.4/.1/.6/.10/.35/.108/.111/.151/.200/.235(B)/.246 (its DEPLOY-side complement: §11.4.246 governs how the artifact is BUILT, §11.4.264 that it is not built AGAIN)/.248/.252/.265/§1.1. Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-264-PROPAGATION` (literal `11.4.264`) + recommended gates `CM-BUILD-ONCE-PROMOTE-DIGEST` + `CM-DEPLOY-CONFIG-INJECTED-NOT-BAKED` + paired §1.1 mutations (add a second per-environment build, or swap a promoted digest for a mutable tag, or bake an environment endpoint into the build → the gates FAIL; golden-FALSE per §11.4.201(1): one build + N digest-referencing promotions MUST NOT fire either); gate-code = separate work item, NOT claimed shipped (§11.4.6/§11.4.227). **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.264. Non-compliance is a release blocker. No escape hatch — no `--rebuild-per-environment`, `--promote-by-tag`, `--bake-env-config-at-build`, `--rebuild-until-green`, `--skip-digest-pin`, `--deterministic-build-means-rebuild-is-safe` flag.
**§11.4.264 — Build once, promote ONE immutable content-addressed artifact through every environment; never rebuild per stage (research-derived, 2026-08-20).** Compact summary: exactly ONE artifact is produced per release candidate and THAT artifact is promoted through every environment; rebuilding per stage silently BREAKS THE CHAIN OF EVIDENCE, because every gate that ran against the staging artifact measured a DIFFERENT binary than production runs — making each of those green verdicts a §11.4 PASS-bluff about the shipped artifact (corpus module 31: *"The thing you tested must be the thing you ship … Rebuilding per environment silently breaks the chain of evidence"*; red flag: *"'We rebuild for production to be safe.'"*). (A) BUILD ONCE per release candidate under §11.4.246 (reproducible + hermetic + SLSA-L2); determinism makes a rebuild detectably equivalent, it is never a licence to rebuild instead of promote. (B) IDENTITY IS A CONTENT ADDRESS — a digest, never a mutable tag (*"tags get re-pushed; digests cannot change without changing the digest"*; the attack defended is *"the same version, different bytes"*), composing §11.4.111 and §11.4.200 (identity read BACK from the intended target). (C) PROMOTION IS A VERIFICATION — *"verify this exact digest is authentic and approved for the next environment," not "make a new thing and hope it's equivalent"*; signature/SBOM/provenance travel WITH the bytes. (D) ENVIRONMENT CONFIG IS INJECTED AT DEPLOY, NEVER BAKED AT BUILD (baking per-environment config re-creates the per-stage rebuild; §11.4.10 still forbids baking a secret). (E) ROLLBACK IS DETERMINISTIC BY CONSEQUENCE — point at the previous known-good digest, *"not a rebuild-from-source scramble under incident pressure"* — the precondition that makes §11.4.265's auto-abort a real undo. (F) REBUILD-TO-DODGE IS GATE-EVASION — *"re-running until green, or rebuilding to get a different result, launders a real failure into a pass"*; retries are counted and surfaced (§11.4.248). Honest boundary §11.4.6 — guarantees the tested bytes are the shipped bytes; does NOT prove them correct (§11.4.108/§11.4.40/§11.4.185), that the deploy reached the intended target (§11.4.200), or that injected config is right (§11.4.254). Classification: universal (§11.4.17); environment ladder, digest scheme and config-injection mechanism are consumer DATA per §11.4.35. Composes §11.4/.1/.6/.10/.35/.108/.111/.151/.200/.235(B)/.246 (its DEPLOY-side complement: §11.4.246 governs how the artifact is BUILT, §11.4.264 that it is not built AGAIN)/.248/.252/.265/§1.1. **§11.4.265 — Progressive delivery: traffic-shifted rollout gated by automated analysis on SLO **and business** metrics, with automatic abort to stable (research-derived, 2026-08-20).** Compact summary: a release reaches users by a bounded-blast-radius strategy — CANARY (gradual weighted traffic shift, smallest blast radius, old+new run concurrently so schema/compat must tolerate it) or BLUE-GREEN (full parallel stand-up, one-shot cutover, rollback window; *"at the switch, all users hit the new version simultaneously"*) — never an ungated cutover; for §11.4.239 critical-invariant surfaces the corpus prefers canary with blue-green's instant-undo posture. (B) THE PROMOTE/ABORT DECISION IS AUTOMATED, NOT A HUMAN WATCHING A DASHBOARD — a controller compares the canary against the stable baseline over successive analysis windows and *"auto-promotes … or auto-aborts and rolls back all traffic to stable — no human needed"*; a manual approval click is explicitly rejected (*"Manual LGTM is a rubber stamp with no receipt; under agents it looks like oversight while providing none"*), composing §11.4.240 and §11.4.262. (C) THE LOAD-BEARING CLAUSE — THE ANALYSIS MUST INCLUDE BUSINESS METRICS, NOT ONLY INFRASTRUCTURE METRICS; the corpus names infra-only measurement *"the classic mistake"*: *"'HTTP error rate is fine' does not tell you the checkout-completion rate quietly dropped 2% … the failures that matter most are business failures that look technically green. So the analysis must include business KPIs, or it re-creates the 'green pipeline that proves nothing' at the deploy layer."* An infra-only canary is a §11.4 PASS-bluff wearing a rollout's uniform. (D) MULTIPLE CONSECUTIVE ANALYSIS WINDOWS, never a single sample (§11.4.50/§11.4.107). (E) POST-DEPLOY SMOKE IS A FAIL-CLOSED PRECONDITION OF TRAFFIC (§11.4.252/§11.4.254). (F) THE DEPLOY GATE IS INDEPENDENT OF THE MERGE GATE — *"'got it merged' is not 'got it shipped.'"* (G) THRESHOLDS AND WINDOW COUNTS ARE CONSUMER DATA, NEVER CONSTITUTIONAL LITERALS — the corpus writes its abort criterion with UNFILLED placeholders (*"below X% or p99 exceeds Y ms … (thresholds illustrative — set from your SLOs)"*) and warns *"A release gate that quotes a stale requirement is itself a bluff."* Honest boundary §11.4.6 — bounds blast radius and automates undo; does NOT prove the release correct, does NOT replace §11.4.185 manual QA, and does NOT apply where no traffic-shiftable surface exists (honest §11.4.3 SKIP-with-reason, never a fabricated canary). The corpus's progressive delivery is exclusively traffic-shifting; it is silent on feature flags / dark launch / kill switches / shadow traffic and none is mandated, and it contains no "a deploy you cannot roll back is not a deploy" claim. Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Composes §11.4/.1/.3/.5/.6/.35/.50/.69/.107/.185/.201/.235/.238/.239/.240/.252/.254/.262/.264/§1.1. Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-265-PROPAGATION` (literal `11.4.265`) + recommended gates `CM-PROGRESSIVE-DELIVERY-STRATEGY-DECLARED` + `CM-CANARY-ANALYSIS-INCLUDES-BUSINESS-METRIC` + paired §1.1 mutations (strip every business metric leaving infra-only, or replace the automated abort with a manual approval → the gates FAIL; golden-FALSE: a non-routable artifact with an honest SKIP-with-reason MUST NOT fire either); gate-code = separate work item, NOT claimed shipped (§11.4.6/§11.4.227). **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.265. Non-compliance is a release blocker. No escape hatch — no `--full-cutover-ok`, `--infra-metrics-suffice`, `--manual-approval-is-the-gate`, `--single-window-analysis`, `--skip-smoke-before-traffic`, `--merge-implies-deploy` flag.

(B) THE PROMOTE/ABORT DECISION IS AUTOMATED, NOT A HUMAN WATCHING A DASHBOARD — a controller compares the canary against the stable baseline over successive analysis windows and *"auto-promotes … or auto-aborts and rolls back all traffic to stable — no human needed"*; a manual approval click is explicitly rejected (*"Manual LGTM is a rubber stamp with no receipt; under agents it looks like oversight while providing none"*), composing §11.4.240 and §11.4.262. (C) THE LOAD-BEARING CLAUSE — THE ANALYSIS MUST INCLUDE BUSINESS METRICS, NOT ONLY INFRASTRUCTURE METRICS; the corpus names infra-only measurement *"the classic mistake"*: *"'HTTP error rate is fine' does not tell you the checkout-completion rate quietly dropped 2% … the failures that matter most are business failures that look technically green. So the analysis must include business KPIs, or it re-creates the 'green pipeline that proves nothing' at the deploy layer."* An infra-only canary is a §11.4 PASS-bluff wearing a rollout's uniform. (D) MULTIPLE CONSECUTIVE ANALYSIS WINDOWS, never a single sample (§11.4.50/§11.4.107). (E) POST-DEPLOY SMOKE IS A FAIL-CLOSED PRECONDITION OF TRAFFIC (§11.4.252/§11.4.254). (F) THE DEPLOY GATE IS INDEPENDENT OF THE MERGE GATE — *"'got it merged' is not 'got it shipped.'"* (G) THRESHOLDS AND WINDOW COUNTS ARE CONSUMER DATA, NEVER CONSTITUTIONAL LITERALS — the corpus writes its abort criterion with UNFILLED placeholders (*"below X% or p99 exceeds Y ms … (thresholds illustrative — set from your SLOs)"*) and warns *"A release gate that quotes a stale requirement is itself a bluff."* Honest boundary §11.4.6 — bounds blast radius and automates undo; does NOT prove the release correct, does NOT replace §11.4.185 manual QA, and does NOT apply where no traffic-shiftable surface exists (honest §11.4.3 SKIP-with-reason, never a fabricated canary). The corpus's progressive delivery is exclusively traffic-shifting; it is silent on feature flags / dark launch / kill switches / shadow traffic and none is mandated, and it contains no "a deploy you cannot roll back is not a deploy" claim. Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Composes §11.4/.1/.3/.5/.6/.35/.50/.69/.107/.185/.201/.235/.238/.239/.240/.252/.254/.262/.264/§1.1. Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-265-PROPAGATION` (literal `11.4.265`) + recommended gates `CM-PROGRESSIVE-DELIVERY-STRATEGY-DECLARED` + `CM-CANARY-ANALYSIS-INCLUDES-BUSINESS-METRIC` + paired §1.1 mutations (strip every business metric leaving infra-only, or replace the automated abort with a manual approval → the gates FAIL; golden-FALSE: a non-routable artifact with an honest SKIP-with-reason MUST NOT fire either); gate-code = separate work item, NOT claimed shipped (§11.4.6/§11.4.227). **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.265. Non-compliance is a release blocker. No escape hatch — no `--full-cutover-ok`, `--infra-metrics-suffice`, `--manual-approval-is-the-gate`, `--single-window-analysis`, `--skip-smoke-before-traffic`, `--merge-implies-deploy` flag.

**§11.4.266 — Claim-vs-reality ledger: every ADVERTISED capability is a row, typed from the closed bluff-type vocabulary, and a capability with no passing challenge is a release blocker (research-derived, 2026-08-20).** Compact summary: corpus module 35 names this the FIRST and cheapest of its portfolio gates — *"A shared claim-vs-reality ledger per repo … every advertised capability is a row with a Bluff type and a severity, and a capability with no passing challenge is a release blocker. This makes stubbed-core, byte-identical-fork, and config-present-but-unwired visible and blocking rather than discovered later."* THE DIRECTION OF ENUMERATION IS THE POINT and is what no existing anchor supplies: §11.4.25's coverage ledger, §11.4.52's autonomous-path column and §11.4.169's test-type column are all keyed on FEATURES the project knows it has; a claim-vs-reality ledger is keyed on what the project ADVERTISES (README, docs, API/CLI surface, §11.4.254 capability matrix, §11.4.259 badges), so a claim with no feature row is invisible to a feature-keyed ledger by construction — §11.4.266 adds a keying, not a restatement (§11.4.227). (A) ONE LEDGER PER REPOSITORY, claim-side; the advertised-surface set is consumer DATA (§11.4.35). (B) EACH ROW CARRIES A BLUFF TYPE FROM THE CLOSED SEVEN-MEMBER VOCABULARY — `green-but-broken` / `coverage-theater` / `rubber-stamp-verified` / `stubbed-core` / `doc-vs-code-drift` / `config-present-but-unwired` / `byte-identical-fork` — plus a severity (the corpus states NO severity scale; consumer DATA). (C) THE TYPE IS A ROUTING KEY TO A COUNTER-GATE — *"it turns 'another bug' into 'another instance of type T,' which is what lets you install one gate that kills the whole type"* — each type binding to the anchor that already owns its counter (§11.4.108/.262, §1.1/§11.4.224(C), §11.4.146(D3)/.240/.249, §11.4.27/.254, §11.4.106/.186/.227, §11.4.124/.196(F), §11.4.251); §11.4.266 makes the ROUTING mandatory, it does not restate the counters. (D) THE RELEASE-BLOCKING RULE — a row whose challenge is absent, never executed, or executed only against a stale artifact fingerprint blocks exactly as a FAILING challenge does (§11.4.135/§11.4.236 absence-blocks-as-FAIL, applied to the claim side). (E) THE ESCAPE HALF is §11.4.238's, cited not duplicated. **PROVENANCE CORRECTION (§11.4.6):** secondary project documentation has called this material an "`FP-1 … FP-14`" catalogue, an "`L-1 … L-16`" list, and an "`F-1 … F-31`" bluff taxonomy; measured against the tracked corpus, **no `F-n`, `FP-n` or `L-n` identifier exists in any of the nine modules** (control-needle proven — the same scan returns the real `ATM-277`/`ATM-343`/`LVA-098`/`ITE-6`/`API-33` ids and 0 for a negative control). The real structures are a 14-row numbered failure-pattern table, a 6-bullet portfolio-gate list, and this 7-member bluff-type vocabulary; those labels MUST NOT be cited as corpus wording. Honest boundary §11.4.6 — proves every ADVERTISED capability has a passing challenge; does NOT prove the challenge strong (§11.4.245/§11.4.107(10)/§1.1), the capability bug-free (§11.4.118), or enumerate capabilities nobody advertised (claim-keyed and feature-keyed ledgers are complements; running one leaves an honestly-stated blind side). Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Composes §11.4/.1/.6/.25/.27/.35/.52/.106/.108/.115(F)/.118/.124/.135/.146(D3)/.169/.186/.196(F)/.197/.212/.224/.226/.227/.236/.238/.240/.245/.249/.251/.254/.257/.259/.262/§1.1. Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-266-PROPAGATION` (literal `11.4.266`) + recommended gates `CM-CLAIM-REALITY-LEDGER-COMPLETE` + `CM-UNCHALLENGED-CAPABILITY-BLOCKS-RELEASE` + `CM-LEDGER-ROW-TYPED-FROM-CLOSED-VOCABULARY` + paired §1.1 mutations (advertise a capability with no row, blank a row's challenge, or retype a row to an invented type → the gates FAIL; golden-FALSE: a fully-populated ledger with fresh candidate-fingerprinted PASS verdicts MUST NOT fire any); gate-code = separate work item, NOT claimed shipped (§11.4.6/§11.4.227). **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.266. **§11.4.267 — Shared attempt record + converge-on-evidence / escalate-on-stall: a failed approach is never silently retried, and a non-converging loop is itself a signal (research-derived, 2026-08-20).** Compact summary: corpus module 34 — *"No memory of what was tried → the loop repeats itself. Agents re-attempt discarded approaches. Fix: a shared record of attempts and outcomes (in the task state / PR thread), so a failed approach is not silently retried; and an escalation rule — after N failed iterations, stop and route to a human or a stronger model, rather than burning cycles."* The premise that makes it structural: *"The agent has no memory of prior attempts. It will re-implement the same wrong fix because it does not remember the last three"* — so the record is externalised memory, not a convenience log. WHAT THIS IS NOT (the §11.4.227 boundary, stated first): §11.4.147 governs a CRASHED agent, §11.4.232(C) a HUNG long-op, §11.4.21 the TERMINAL exhaustion audit — none governs a LIVE, HEALTHY, PROGRESSING loop re-walking a dead end its predecessor already proved dead; §11.4.267 closes exactly that gap. (A) A SHARED, DURABLE ATTEMPT RECORD across every actor that may take the next attempt (successor agent, §11.4.147 respawn, §11.4.176 other track); the §11.4.93 DB and §11.4.116 event stream are the substrates and MUST be reused, not duplicated. (B) CONSULTED BEFORE ACTING — the record is READ before the next attempt; a recorded-failed approach is not silently retried, and a re-attempt is permitted only on a recorded material difference (changed precondition, corrected §11.4.199 sequence, new §11.4.115(F) RED); a written-but-never-read record is the §11.4.196(F) configured-≠-in-use failure applied to agent memory. (C) CONVERGE ON EVIDENCE — *"Each loop must monotonically reduce uncertainty"*, on a SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH (*"the verifier's build exit 1 beats the producer's fluent paragraph every time"*) with CONCRETE FAILURE FEEDBACK (*"feed the exact captured error (argv, exit code, failing assertion, the offending line) back as the next input"*). (D) STALL IS A DETECTED SIGNAL WITH A BOUNDED RETRY AND AN ESCALATION PATH — two named signatures (*"the same criterion red after N tries"*, *"oscillating diffs"*), the stall itself tracked and trended, and the forbidden shape explicit: *"an unbounded retry loop with no ground-truth feedback and no escalation — that is how agents thrash expensively while appearing busy."* Escalation composes §11.4.231 (re-tier), §11.4.101, §11.4.66/§11.4.21. (E) `N` IS CONSUMER DATA, NEVER A CONSTITUTIONAL LITERAL — the corpus leaves `N` symbolic in every occurrence and states no numeric, wall-clock, token or cost bound; this anchor mandates that a bound EXISTS and is DECLARED, never a value. (F) THE LOOP'S DONE-CONDITION — not satisfied while an attempt is in-flight with no outcome, and every escalation reaches a terminal disposition (§11.4.87/.94/.97/.126/.147/.197). Honest boundary §11.4.6 — prevents the RECORDED dead end from being re-walked; does NOT guarantee convergence (an escalation is an honest outcome), prove any attempt competent, or substitute for §11.4.102. Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Composes §11.4.6/.20/.21/.35/.66/.70/.87/.93/.94/.97/.101/.102/.115(F)/.116/.126/.146/.147/.176/.187/.196(F)/.197/.199/.231/.232(C)/.240/.249/.262/§1.1. Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-267-PROPAGATION` (literal `11.4.267`) + recommended gates `CM-ATTEMPT-RECORD-SHARED-AND-CONSULTED` + `CM-STALL-BOUNDED-AND-ESCALATED` + paired §1.1 mutations (dispatch blind without reading the record, remove the retry bound, or record an escalation with no terminal disposition → the gates FAIL; golden-FALSE: a loop converging on attempt 2 with both attempts recorded MUST NOT fire either); gate-code = separate work item, NOT claimed shipped (§11.4.6/§11.4.227). **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.267. Non-compliance is a release blocker. No escape hatch — no `--no-attempt-record`, `--record-without-reading`, `--unbounded-retry-loop`, `--retry-same-failed-approach`, `--stall-without-escalation`, `--invent-N-and-cite-corpus` flag.

(A) A SHARED, DURABLE ATTEMPT RECORD across every actor that may take the next attempt (successor agent, §11.4.147 respawn, §11.4.176 other track); the §11.4.93 DB and §11.4.116 event stream are the substrates and MUST be reused, not duplicated. (B) CONSULTED BEFORE ACTING — the record is READ before the next attempt; a recorded-failed approach is not silently retried, and a re-attempt is permitted only on a recorded material difference (changed precondition, corrected §11.4.199 sequence, new §11.4.115(F) RED); a written-but-never-read record is the §11.4.196(F) configured-≠-in-use failure applied to agent memory. (C) CONVERGE ON EVIDENCE — *"Each loop must monotonically reduce uncertainty"*, on a SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH (*"the verifier's build exit 1 beats the producer's fluent paragraph every time"*) with CONCRETE FAILURE FEEDBACK (*"feed the exact captured error (argv, exit code, failing assertion, the offending line) back as the next input"*). (D) STALL IS A DETECTED SIGNAL WITH A BOUNDED RETRY AND AN ESCALATION PATH — two named signatures (*"the same criterion red after N tries"*, *"oscillating diffs"*), the stall itself tracked and trended, and the forbidden shape explicit: *"an unbounded retry loop with no ground-truth feedback and no escalation — that is how agents thrash expensively while appearing busy."* Escalation composes §11.4.231 (re-tier), §11.4.101, §11.4.66/§11.4.21. (E) `N` IS CONSUMER DATA, NEVER A CONSTITUTIONAL LITERAL — the corpus leaves `N` symbolic in every occurrence and states no numeric, wall-clock, token or cost bound; this anchor mandates that a bound EXISTS and is DECLARED, never a value. (F) THE LOOP'S DONE-CONDITION — not satisfied while an attempt is in-flight with no outcome, and every escalation reaches a terminal disposition (§11.4.87/.94/.97/.126/.147/.197). Honest boundary §11.4.6 — prevents the RECORDED dead end from being re-walked; does NOT guarantee convergence (an escalation is an honest outcome), prove any attempt competent, or substitute for §11.4.102. Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Composes §11.4.6/.20/.21/.35/.66/.70/.87/.93/.94/.97/.101/.102/.115(F)/.116/.126/.146/.147/.176/.187/.196(F)/.197/.199/.231/.232(C)/.240/.249/.262/§1.1. Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-267-PROPAGATION` (literal `11.4.267`) + recommended gates `CM-ATTEMPT-RECORD-SHARED-AND-CONSULTED` + `CM-STALL-BOUNDED-AND-ESCALATED` + paired §1.1 mutations (dispatch blind without reading the record, remove the retry bound, or record an escalation with no terminal disposition → the gates FAIL; golden-FALSE: a loop converging on attempt 2 with both attempts recorded MUST NOT fire either); gate-code = separate work item, NOT claimed shipped (§11.4.6/§11.4.227). **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.267. Non-compliance is a release blocker. No escape hatch — no `--no-attempt-record`, `--record-without-reading`, `--unbounded-retry-loop`, `--retry-same-failed-approach`, `--stall-without-escalation`, `--invent-N-and-cite-corpus` flag.
**§11.4.267 — Shared attempt record + converge-on-evidence / escalate-on-stall: a failed approach is never silently retried, and a non-converging loop is itself a signal (research-derived, 2026-08-20).** Compact summary: corpus module 34 — *"No memory of what was tried → the loop repeats itself. Agents re-attempt discarded approaches. Fix: a shared record of attempts and outcomes (in the task state / PR thread), so a failed approach is not silently retried; and an escalation rule — after N failed iterations, stop and route to a human or a stronger model, rather than burning cycles."* The premise that makes it structural: *"The agent has no memory of prior attempts. It will re-implement the same wrong fix because it does not remember the last three"* — so the record is externalised memory, not a convenience log. Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-267-PROPAGATION` (literal `11.4.267`) + recommended gates `CM-ATTEMPT-RECORD-SHARED-AND-CONSULTED` + `CM-STALL-BOUNDED-AND-ESCALATED` + paired §1.1 mutations (dispatch blind without reading the record, remove the retry bound, or record an escalation with no terminal disposition → the gates FAIL; golden-FALSE: a loop converging on attempt 2 with both attempts recorded MUST NOT fire either); gate-code = separate work item, NOT claimed shipped (§11.4.6/§11.4.227). **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.267. **§11.4.272 — Dynamic, on-demand skill/extension activation (User mandate, 2026-09-07).** Cascade reference (short form): the ACTIVE capability surface (Agent Skills, plugins, extensions, tool sets) MUST be the MINIMUM genuinely needed at that moment, with everything else inactive by default and activatable ON DEMAND — a static all-on set is paid for in every turn of every session (measured 2026-09-07, Claude Code 2.1.263: a 955-skill pool renders as 29,153 B / ~7,288 tok of NAMES per turn, or 101,279 B / ~25,319 tok with descriptions — a 3.5x render-mode cliff the project does not control; byte counts exact, token conversion a labelled bytes/4 estimate). ALL hold: (A) a deliberately small declared `core`, everything else on demand, the manifest supplied as consumer DATA (§11.4.35); (B) DISCOVERABILITY IS NEVER TRADED FOR TOKENS — a deactivated capability stays findable via an always-available index and §11.4.102(B) still binds unconditionally; (C) FAIL SAFE NEVER SILENT (§11.4.201) — a failed activation says so explicitly, exits non-zero, and leaves nothing dangling, so the agent never believes it holds a tool it does not; (D) CONCURRENCY-SAFE reference counting (§11.4.119/§11.4.176/§11.4.180/§11.4.174) so one session never strips a capability another live session is using; (E) HONEST ASYMMETRY — built on PROVEN platform behaviour, not documented behaviour (measured: activation hot-loads mid-session, deactivation does NOT hot-unload; and `permissions.deny` `Skill(name)` blocks invocation WITHOUT removing the rendered entry, saving zero tokens — a first-party mechanism must be TESTED for the property relied on, never assumed, so §11.4.74 is satisfied by evidence); (F) a BUDGET GATE bounds the active surface in BOTH render modes so an upstream switch to description-eager rendering breaks LOUDLY; (G) BOTH MODES — the engine lives in the constitution submodule (§11.4.28/§11.4.80/§11.4.177, by reference never copied) yet a project WITHOUT the submodule still gets a working command or an HONEST LOUD refusal with a distinct exit code naming what is unavailable, why, where it looked and what still works — never a silent no-op (REQ-NOTE-0001); (H) PRUNE-TO-CORE IS THE DEFAULT and is NOT a §11.4.122 removal (operator decision 2026-09-07) — session-init DEMOTES every non-core capability rather than merely raising `core` (raise-only satisfies (A) in letter and voids it in substance: the surface grows monotonically as capabilities accumulate; measured on the reference project 19 active / 422 B / ~105 tok-per-turn raise-only vs 3 active / 65 B / ~16 tok-per-turn prune-by-default), and it is NOT the silent removal §11.4.122 forbids because all three reversibility properties hold BY CONSTRUCTION — LISTED (the always-core catalogue of (B) still shows every pruned capability), ACTIVATABLE (one command returns it, hot-loading per (E)), NOT DELETED (a link-style activation loses only the LINK with its target untouched, and a sole-copy capability is MOVED to a preserved store that is itself a searched source — zero bytes destroyed), so a pruned capability is dormant and one command away, materially unlike dropping a component from a build; an unsafe demotion — another live session's claim per (D), a name collision in the preserved store (never clobber preserved content, §9.2), a move that fails or lands unreadable (it is REVERTED), or a capability that would not be re-activatable afterwards — MUST refuse LOUDLY and leave it ACTIVE per (C); relocation MUST be relocation-SAFE (path-relative references inside a capability re-pointed at the identical resolved target before the move, the post-move readability check the backstop that refuses and reverts); an EXPLICIT, DOCUMENTED opt-out MUST exist at session scope (an environment override) and project scope (a manifest flag), session scope winning, because a mechanism with no way out gets worked around destructively; and where the engine is unreachable pruning inherits (G)'s honest refusal — a session is NEVER left silently holding fewer capabilities than it believes it has. Honest boundary (§11.4.6): this reduces the cost of the capability LIST, not of a skill BODY once invoked, is never a licence to hide a capability the task needed, and clause (H) inherits (E)'s measured asymmetry — the saving lands at the next session start for anything the platform already cached, so prune runs AT session initialisation and its in-session effect is never overclaimed. Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-272-PROPAGATION` (literal `11.4.272`) + recommended gates `CM-SKILL-SURFACE-BUDGET` / `CM-SKILL-ACTIVATION-FAIL-SAFE` / `CM-SKILL-PRUNE-PRESERVES-CONTENT` (after a prune every demoted capability is still LISTED, still ACTIVATABLE, and its content byte-identical to its pre-prune state; an unsafe demotion refuses and leaves the capability ACTIVE) + paired §1.1 mutation (make the demotion DESTRUCTIVE, or strip the relocation-safety step, or strip the other-live-session claim check → the prune gate MUST FAIL). **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](constitution/Constitution.md) §11.4.272 — the full mandate text is canonical there and is inherited by reference (CONST-059 / §11.4.35). Non-compliance is a release blocker.

**§11.4.273 — Measuring-instrument verification: a census that INFORMS a decision must be control-needled before its result is believed (research-derived, 2026-09-08).** Forensic anchor: FIFTEEN instances in one session where an ad-hoc measurement returned a confident, plausible, actionable result that was an artefact of the instrument, not a property of the system — a pattern matching only one of two block-opener forms (manufacturing 24 phantom findings); `comm` on numerically-sorted input reporting all 34 items missing; `$?` read after a pipeline turning exit 1 into 0; a field-name typo reading as "every record lost its key binding"; `grep -w` matching `zai` inside `zai-coding-plan` and corrupting a classification; a summary grep assuming `passed, failed` when failure prints `failed, passed`; `while read` dropping an unterminated final line so a one-element list iterated zero times; a mutation applied with the wrong env knob so the REAL tree was tested and the green meant nothing; a guard probe using a command the guard does not target, proving nothing while reading as a negative; a fixture whose two columns held the same string, so a real column-swap mutation survived at 52/0 under a comment asserting that could not happen; a positive control chosen OUTSIDE the instrument's scope reporting a working instrument as broken, and another chosen to BE the question under test so it could not discriminate; an `awk` range whose escaping matched nothing reporting 838 rows where the system held 134, about to gate a DESTRUCTIVE recreate; **a two-literal denylist searched with ONE literal** — both loaded, both lengths printed, one searched — so a live credential was reported eliminated while still handed over in four copy-pasteable lines per file, with the positive control PASSING because it shared the same single needle; and `$?` clobbered by a command substitution in the same argument list, reporting a `pandoc` failure (exit 64) as exit 0. **The gap:** §11.4.201 governs guards/gates (instruments that BLOCK) and §11.4.107(10) governs analyzers (calibrated golden-good/bad); NEITHER covers the ad-hoc census that INFORMS — a grep, a set difference, an exit-code read, a field lookup — whose output is not a verdict but a FACT a decision is then built on, written inline, used once, trusted implicitly, never itself tested. **Mandate:** any measurement whose result will drive a decision, claim, classification or report MUST be control-needled BEFORE it is acted on — **(a)** a POSITIVE control (a value known present must be found: catches too-narrow patterns, wrong field names, wrong paths, wrong knobs, silently-empty stages); **(b)** a NEGATIVE control (a fabricated needle must NOT be found: catches too-broad patterns, accidental substring/word-boundary matches, fabricating defaults); **(c)** an EMPTY result is NEVER a finding alone — absent, could-not-look, looked-in-the-wrong-place and output-shape-differed are four distinct states the raw empty distinguishes between none of (§11.4.6); **(d)** a result CONTRADICTING directly-observed evidence is presumed an instrument fault until proven otherwise; **(e)** the instrument is part of the evidence — a captured claim cites the command that produced it (§11.4.5/§11.4.2); **(f)** when the criterion is a SET, the control must cover EVERY member — needling ONE member proves only that member is searchable, and (a) and (b) both PASS while the answer is wrong if the search and its control share the same single needle (measured: a two-literal denylist searched with one literal reported a live credential eliminated while it was still handed over in four copy-pasteable lines per file); **(g)** capture an exit status BEFORE any other expansion can overwrite it — `$?` is the LAST command's status, which in a compound statement is often not the one being reported on, whether a pipeline's last stage or a command substitution earlier in the same argument list. **Honest boundary (§11.4.6):** control needles prove an instrument can tell PRESENT from ABSENT; they do NOT prove it measures the RIGHT property, and a correctly-needled census of the wrong thing is still the wrong answer. Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Composes §11.4.5/.6/.2/.107(10)/.118/.201/§1.1. Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-273-PROPAGATION` (literal `11.4.273`) + recommended gate `CM-CENSUS-CONTROL-NEEDLED` + paired §1.1 mutation (gate-code = separate work item, NOT claimed shipped). **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](constitution/Constitution.md) §11.4.273. Non-compliance is a release blocker. No escape hatch — no `--skip-control-needle`, `--empty-is-absent`, `--trust-the-grep`, `--census-needs-no-proof`, `--obvious-result-exempt` flag.

Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Composes §11.4.5/.6/.2/.107(10)/.118/.201/§1.1. Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-273-PROPAGATION` (literal `11.4.273`) + recommended gate `CM-CENSUS-CONTROL-NEEDLED` + paired §1.1 mutation (gate-code = separate work item, NOT claimed shipped). **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](constitution/Constitution.md) §11.4.273. Non-compliance is a release blocker. No escape hatch — no `--skip-control-needle`, `--empty-is-absent`, `--trust-the-grep`, `--census-needs-no-proof`, `--obvious-result-exempt` flag.
**§11.4.273 — Measuring-instrument verification: a census that INFORMS a decision must be control-needled before its result is believed (research-derived, 2026-09-08).** Forensic anchor: FIFTEEN instances in one session where an ad-hoc measurement returned a confident, plausible, actionable result that was an artefact of the instrument, not a property of the system — a pattern matching only one of two block-opener forms (manufacturing 24 phantom findings); `comm` on numerically-sorted input reporting all 34 items missing; `$?` read after a pipeline turning exit 1 into 0; a field-name typo reading as "every record lost its key binding"; `grep -w` matching `zai` inside `zai-coding-plan` and corrupting a classification; a summary grep assuming `passed, failed` when failure prints `failed, passed`; `while read` dropping an unterminated final line so a one-element list iterated zero times; a mutation applied with the wrong env knob so the REAL tree was tested and the green meant nothing; a guard probe using a command the guard does not target, proving nothing while reading as a negative; a fixture whose two columns held the same string, so a real column-swap mutation survived at 52/0 under a comment asserting that could not happen; a positive control chosen OUTSIDE the instrument's scope reporting a working instrument as broken, and another chosen to BE the question under test so it could not discriminate; an `awk` range whose escaping matched nothing reporting 838 rows where the system held 134, about to gate a DESTRUCTIVE recreate; **a two-literal denylist searched with ONE literal** — both loaded, both lengths printed, one searched — so a live credential was reported eliminated while still handed over in four copy-pasteable lines per file, with the positive control PASSING because it shared the same single needle; and `$?` clobbered by a command substitution in the same argument list, reporting a `pandoc` failure (exit 64) as exit 0. **The gap:** §11.4.201 governs guards/gates (instruments that BLOCK) and §11.4.107(10) governs analyzers (calibrated golden-good/bad); NEITHER covers the ad-hoc census that INFORMS — a grep, a set difference, an exit-code read, a field lookup — whose output is not a verdict but a FACT a decision is then built on, written inline, used once, trusted implicitly, never itself tested. **Mandate:** any measurement whose result will drive a decision, claim, classification or report MUST be control-needled BEFORE it is acted on — **(a)** a POSITIVE control (a value known present must be found: catches too-narrow patterns, wrong field names, wrong paths, wrong knobs, silently-empty stages); **(b)** a NEGATIVE control (a fabricated needle must NOT be found: catches too-broad patterns, accidental substring/word-boundary matches, fabricating defaults); **(c)** an EMPTY result is NEVER a finding alone — absent, could-not-look, looked-in-the-wrong-place and output-shape-differed are four distinct states the raw empty distinguishes between none of (§11.4.6); **(d)** a result CONTRADICTING directly-observed evidence is presumed an instrument fault until proven otherwise; **(e)** the instrument is part of the evidence — a captured claim cites the command that produced it (§11.4.5/§11.4.2); **(f)** when the criterion is a SET, the control must cover EVERY member — needling ONE member proves only that member is searchable, and (a) and (b) both PASS while the answer is wrong if the search and its control share the same single needle (measured: a two-literal denylist searched with one literal reported a live credential eliminated while it was still handed over in four copy-pasteable lines per file); **(g)** capture an exit status BEFORE any other expansion can overwrite it — `$?` is the LAST command's status, which in a compound statement is often not the one being reported on, whether a pipeline's last stage or a command substitution earlier in the same argument list. **Honest boundary (§11.4.6):** control needles prove an instrument can tell PRESENT from ABSENT; they do NOT prove it measures the RIGHT property, and a correctly-needled census of the wrong thing is still the wrong answer. Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Composes §11.4.5/.6/.2/.107(10)/.118/.201/§1.1. Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-273-PROPAGATION` (literal `11.4.273`) + recommended gate `CM-CENSUS-CONTROL-NEEDLED` + paired §1.1 mutation (gate-code = separate work item, NOT claimed shipped). **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](constitution/Constitution.md) §11.4.273. Non-compliance is a release blocker. No escape hatch — no `--skip-control-needle`, `--empty-is-absent`, `--trust-the-grep`, `--census-needs-no-proof`, `--obvious-result-exempt` flag.

**§11.4.274 — Mechanical work belongs in a script, not in an agent's context: extract it, test it, and re-scan for it on a cadence (User mandate, 2026-09-08).** Forensic anchor: in one session five review agents consumed ~400–450k tokens EACH, and the dominant cost was not judgment but MECHANICS — copy a tree to scratch, apply a one-line mutation, run a suite, read the summary, restore, verify byte-identical, compare against the previous round, repeat seven times. Every step is deterministic, fixed-input/fixed-output, decision-free: a shell script, executed instead one tool call at a time by a language model at orders of magnitude the cost, with a fresh chance of transcription error at each step (this session logged ten such instrument errors, §11.4.273). **Rule:** work that is DETERMINISTIC, REPEATABLE and contains NO JUDGMENT MUST be delegated to a properly written script or small compiled utility and invoked, not performed turn-by-turn — mutation apply/run/restore/verify loops, suite fan-outs and result tabulation, before/after comparisons, scratch setup and teardown, residue and quiescence scans, census and inventory queries, artifact fingerprinting, evidence collection and layout, and any step already written down as a fixed recipe. **(a) EXTRACT:** a mechanical sequence an agent performs more than twice is a defect in the tooling, not a task — name it, script it, invoke it. **(b) THE TOOL IS GOVERNED:** it ships with actionable documentation (§11.4.18), a user guide/manual entry where operator-facing, and tests validating its behaviour AND producing machine evidence deterministically (§11.4.50/§11.4.5) — including failure paths, exit-code semantics (§11.4.201) and the control needles proving its own measurements (§11.4.273); replacing a slow correct process with a fast unproven one is a regression, not an optimisation. **(c) RE-SCAN ON A CADENCE:** every project periodically scans itself for mechanical work still done by agents (recurring command sequences in transcripts/logs, repeated inline recipes, "run these commands in order" docs) and refactors the findings out — a standing obligation, since new mechanical loops accrete continuously. **(d) HONEST BOUNDARY (§11.4.6) — what MUST NOT be extracted:** JUDGMENT. Root-cause determination (§11.4.102), review verdicts (§11.4.125/§11.4.142/§11.4.194), the decision that a fix is correct, the choice of what to measure, the reading of whether evidence supports a claim, and any assessment requiring "is this the right thing to check?" A script that renders a verdict is a bluff gate (§11.4.201), and automating a review into a green checkmark is the exact PASS-bluff this constitution exists to prevent. The division is: the SCRIPT gathers and executes deterministically and cheaply; the AGENT decides what it means. Cost is NEVER a reason to move a decision into a script. Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Composes §11.4.18/.50/.5/.141/.201/.273/.124/§1.1. Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-274-PROPAGATION` (literal `11.4.274`) + recommended gates `CM-MECHANICAL-WORK-EXTRACTED` / `CM-EXTRACTED-TOOL-DOCUMENTED-AND-TESTED` + paired §1.1 mutation (gate-code = separate work item, NOT claimed shipped). **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](constitution/Constitution.md) §11.4.274. Non-compliance is a release blocker. No escape hatch — no `--skip-extraction`, `--agent-can-do-it`, `--one-off-is-fine`, `--script-the-review`, `--extract-without-tests` flag.

**§11.4.275 — Semantic (Lumen) index + indexing-efficiency gate + universal agent/subagent accessibility (research-derived, 2026-09-24).** Compact summary: every code index the project maintains — the structural CodeGraph index (§11.4.78) AND the semantic Lumen index, and any future code index — MUST (A) be reachable by EVERY agent AND every dispatched subagent through a server definition they can actually resolve (committed project config or installed plugin); a config that ENABLES a server nothing DECLARES is a violation; proof = a real tool call from a dispatched subagent returning an index-only fact (§11.4.78(4) unforgeable challenge), un-drivable agents = documented §11.4.3 SKIP; (B) for the semantic index: embedding model provisioned rootless (§11.4.161) and proven by a real embed call returning the declared dimensions, scope GENERATED from the same class source as the structural scope (`<constitution>/scripts/lumen/gen_lumenignore.py`), health = files AND chunks non-zero + known-symbol hit + negative control + freshness within consumer TTL; (C) be called ready ONLY when pending work == 0, state complete, file count within consumer tolerance of the accepted count, schema indexes present — every count/empty result control-needled (§11.4.273); (D) earn its place by a DETERMINISTIC benchmark (fixed queries + golden answers, index route vs grep+read, N≥3 identical canonical hashes per §11.4.50, bytes/est-tokens/p50/p95/correctness per query), reduction computed ONLY over queries both routes answered correctly, wrong answers listed BY ID and never averaged away, thresholds = consumer DATA (§11.4.35); (E) route structural→CodeGraph, conceptual→Lumen before grep+read (§11.4.141) except measured-wrong query classes (fall back + tracked); (F) root-cause + patch performance defects in the version-keyed runner with RED→GREEN + paired mutation + byte-copy equivalence proof; (G) writes via the single writer entry (§11.4.80(5)), live reads read-only. Forensic FACTS (genericised): a configured semantic server reported 0 files / no model / never indexed; the structural index cut tokens 69.2% over 8 both-correct fixture queries yet answered 5 of 15 fixture queries WRONG (grep+read 2 of 15); one uncached full-table file-list query was 93.4% of resolve time; an FK-cascade stalled the bulk window; a launcher classifying `sync` by stored rows instead of pending backlog ran a tens-of-millions-reference bulk job stock + foreground + unsupervised; the vendor reaps locks by age not liveness and a writable open recreates dropped indexes without the lock; an errored instrument's empty result was nearly read as absence. Latent binding (§11.4.96 pattern): a project with no semantic index is bound only for the indexes it maintains; the semantic clauses bind the moment it adds one. Honest boundary (§11.4.6): proves reachable/complete/scoped/measured, not every answer correct; never licenses narrowing scope to hit a threshold (§11.4.66); the reference benchmark harness is still a prototype outside the constitution tree (landing = owed work). Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-275-PROPAGATION` (literal `11.4.275`) + recommended gates `CM-CODE-INDEX-AGENT-ACCESSIBLE` / `CM-CODE-INDEX-COMPLETE-BEFORE-READY` / `CM-LUMEN-MODEL-PROVEN` / `CM-LUMEN-SCOPED-FRESH` / `CM-CODE-INDEX-BENCH` / `CM-CODEGRAPH-SCOPE-PROOF` / `CM-CODEGRAPH-UPGRADE-PROBE-GATED` / `CM-CODEGRAPH-WRITER-EXCLUSIVE` / `CM-CODEGRAPH-BULK-BY-BACKLOG` / `CM-CODEGRAPH-STALL-WATCHDOG` + paired §1.1 mutations (enabled-undeclared server, ready with pending > 0, reduction without wrong-answer list, unloaded model, bulk-by-rows, dropped liveness check → each gate MUST FAIL; golden-FALSE: unchanged complete reachable index fires none). Gate CODE = separate work item, NOT claimed shipped (§11.4.6 / §11.4.227). **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §11.4.275. Non-compliance is a release blocker. No escape hatch — no `--index-partial-ready`, `--enabled-is-declared`, `--main-session-only-index`, `--skip-model-proof`, `--reduction-without-wrong-answers`, `--bulk-by-row-count`, `--lock-age-is-liveness` flag.
**§11.4.275 — Semantic (Lumen) index + indexing-efficiency gate + universal agent/subagent accessibility (research-derived, 2026-09-24).** Compact summary: every code index the project maintains — the structural CodeGraph index (§11.4.78) AND the semantic Lumen index, and any future code index — MUST (A) be reachable by EVERY agent AND every dispatched subagent through a server definition they can actually resolve (committed project config or installed plugin); a config that ENABLES a server nothing DECLARES is a violation; proof = a real tool call from a dispatched subagent returning an index-only fact (§11.4.78(4) unforgeable challenge), un-drivable agents = documented §11.4.3 SKIP; (B) for the semantic index: embedding model provisioned rootless (§11.4.161) and proven by a real embed call returning the declared dimensions, scope GENERATED from the same class source as the structural scope (`<constitution>/scripts/lumen/gen_lumenignore.py`), health = files AND chunks non-zero + known-symbol hit + negative control + freshness within consumer TTL; (C) be called ready ONLY when pending work == 0, state complete, file count within consumer tolerance of the accepted count, schema indexes present — every count/empty result control-needled (§11.4.273); (D) earn its place by a DETERMINISTIC benchmark (fixed queries + golden answers, index route vs grep+read, N≥3 identical canonical hashes per §11.4.50, bytes/est-tokens/p50/p95/correctness per query), reduction computed ONLY over queries both routes answered correctly, wrong answers listed BY ID and never averaged away, thresholds = consumer DATA (§11.4.35); (E) route structural→CodeGraph, conceptual→Lumen before grep+read (§11.4.141) except measured-wrong query classes (fall back + tracked); (F) root-cause + patch performance defects in the version-keyed runner with RED→GREEN + paired mutation + byte-copy equivalence proof; (G) writes via the single writer entry (§11.4.80(5)), live reads read-only. **§12.12 — Process/thread-limit (RLIMIT_NPROC) awareness for parallel subagent/multi-process work (User mandate, 2026-07-07).** Compact summary: heavy parallel subagent/multi-process work is bounded by the OS per-user process/thread limit `ulimit -u` (`RLIMIT_NPROC`, Linux counts ALL threads+processes of the real UID, not per-process); the ambient tooling fleet (MCP servers, tokio/V8/libuv worker runtimes, `mongod`/`chrome`/`prisma`-class MCP servers, local LLM servers) consumes a large FIXED fraction before project work starts — FORENSIC FACT (2026-07-07): a host at `ulimit -u 4096` sat at ~3900-4005 threads from the ambient fleet alone (<150 headroom); a 4th Go-heavy subagent (`GOMAXPROCS=nproc` spawns dozens of threads) hit `EAGAIN`/`failed to create new OS thread (errno=11)` and crashed tooling; stopping 3 non-essential MCP servers freed ~1345 threads (3827→2482). Mandate: BEFORE scaling parallel subagents/processes, check thread headroom (`ulimit -u` soft + `ulimit -Hu` hard + live `ps -L --no-headers -u "$USER" | wc -l`) and treat exhaustion as a §12 host-safety event that YIELDS UNCONDITIONALLY — the ORTHOGONAL second exhaustion axis alongside §12.6's memory ceiling (abundant RAM ≠ abundant thread budget); signals `EAGAIN`/`fork: retry`/`failed to create new OS thread`/`cannot allocate memory` on fork/clone (distinct from OOM, §11.4.6 no-guessing — never conflate); low headroom ⇒ SERIALIZE, avoid `GOMAXPROCS=nproc`-class spikes, never dispatch blind (a subagent hitting `EAGAIN` mid-`git push` is a §9.2 data-safety risk). Three raising techniques: (a) no-restart `prlimit --pid <PID> --nproc=<soft>:<hard>` (root, e.g. `su -c`) — new children of a running process inherit the raise; (b) persistent `/etc/security/limits.conf` (`<user> hard/soft nproc <N>`) or systemd `LimitNPROC=<N>`, next login; (c) self-raise `ulimit -u <N>` up to the existing hard ceiling within the current session — `su -c "ulimit -u N"` sets the limit ONLY inside that transient subshell, NOT the already-running session. Freeing threads (stopping non-essential MCP servers) REQUIRES operator authorization (§11.4.122, no autonomous tooling removal); CAUTION `pkill -f`/`pgrep -f` match the killer's OWN command line — always exclude the caller's `$$`/`$PPID` (and conductor PID) from any cmdline-pattern kill list to avoid self-kill. Classification: universal (§11.4.17). Composes §12/.6/.7/§11.4.58/.101/.103/.122/§9.2. Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-12-12-PROPAGATION` (literal `12.12`) + recommended gate `CM-NPROC-HEADROOM-CHECK` + paired §1.1 mutation. **Canonical authority:** constitution submodule [`Constitution.md`](Constitution.md) §12.12. Non-compliance is a release blocker. No escape hatch — no `--ignore-thread-limit`, `--dispatch-blind`, `--skip-headroom-check`, `--autonomous-tooling-kill`, `--assume-ulimit-scope` flag.

A commit (especially `git add -A` / any broad stage) MUST NOT run while a build/packaging/generation step is actively writing artifacts INTO tracked (version-controlled) directories — doing so races the writer and stages a PARTIAL or stale artifact (a §11.4.108 SOURCE→ARTIFACT integrity failure landed in version control). The commit MUST be deferred until the build step that writes tracked artifacts has COMPLETED, so the tree is quiescent at the artifact layer AND the committed artifacts are the FRESH, whole outputs (no stale pre-rebuild artifact, no half-written file). Before committing tracked build outputs, verify the writing step finished (process exit / completion marker / per-artifact mtime ≥ build-start) — a build still in flight writing tracked dirs is a HOLD on the commit, not a race to win. Build-output analogue of §11.4.84 (no commit while a mutation gate is in flight): both close the "commit captures transient non-final tree state" class at two write-sources. Where build outputs land OUTSIDE version control (gitignored `out/` / `dist/`), the race does not apply. Honest boundary (§11.4.6): "the build probably finished" is not "the build finished" — verify with a completion signal; committing source changes that DON'T touch the build's tracked-artifact directories is fine mid-build. The PROJECT-SPECIFIC instance (which tracked directory + which build steps write it) is recorded in the consuming project's own governance per §11.4.35. A fix crosses FOUR distinct layers, and "fixed" at one does NOT imply fixed at the next: (1) **SOURCE** (committed in the source file — what a grep-the-source pre-build gate checks), (2) **ARTIFACT** (the change's BYTES actually landed in the produced build artifact — image / bundle / installer / embedded command-line), (3) **RUNTIME-ON-CLEAN-TARGET** (active on a CLEAN/fresh deployment — the layer the end user experiences — with no stale overlay shadowing the deployed code), (4) **USER-VISIBLE** (the feature works for the end user — the §11.4.5/§11.4.69 captured-evidence layer). Green at layer 1 is the cheapest, least conclusive signal and says nothing about layers 2–4. A gate verifying ONLY the source layer is itself a §11.4 bluff surface.

A remediation/release cycle MUST NOT treat "every reported defect is fixed" as "the build is good" — the reported set is biased by what the operator happened to test ("we only see what we test"). After/alongside fixing the reported set, run a discovery + stress pass across ALL target devices/environments that deliberately exercises subsystems/journeys/edge-cases BEYOND the reported defects — to CONFIRM the reported set is the COMPLETE critical set + surface unreported defects before the user does. The pass MUST produce PROVABLE coverage: an enumerated list of subsystems/journeys/stress-scenarios exercised, each with outcome (no-new-issue, or a new tracker entry per §11.4.15 / §11.4.16). "We found no other issues" is a §11.4 bluff unless paired with "here is the enumerated set we exercised" — absence of evidence of looking is not evidence of absence. New findings trigger §11.4.4 interrupt + §11.4.114/§11.4.115 isolation→RED→fix. After all fixes / changes / implementations in a batch are done, and BEFORE running the pre-build test sweep AND the main (artifact) build (for ANY project), the agent MUST dispatch one or more dedicated code-review agent(s) (subagent-driven by default per §11.4.70/§11.4.20) performing a multi-layer review that: (1) analyzes ALL work done in the batch (every fix/change + its source diff + stated intent); (2) analyzes ALL existing data + facts (captured evidence per §11.4.5/§11.4.69/§11.4.107, tracker entries, prior findings, the §11.4.108 runtime-signature registry); (3) analyzes the existing codebase (blast radius per §11.4.92, cross-feature interaction, contract integrity of every dependency); (4) analyzes current git history (what each change touched, how it composes with concurrent/recent work, whether it reproduces a known-broken pattern per §11.4.114/§11.4.124); (5) determines quality + safety + will-it-REALLY-work (robust + not error-prone — no solve-A-create-B; no host/data/security regression; genuinely delivers the end-user-visible behaviour per §11.4/§107); (6) validates + verifies the tests covering the work — every covering test genuinely exercises the work-under-test and catches its negation, with ZERO chance of a false result or bluff (a test that PASSes on broken-for-the-user work, a metadata-only/config-only/absence-of-error/grep-without-runtime assertion, or a gate whose paired §1.1 mutation does not make it FAIL is a finding). Any finding (defect / error-prone change / safety risk / will-not-really-work / bluff-or-false-result-capable test / missing-coverage gap) MUST be fixed, polished, improved, and covered with additional tests (four-layer per §11.4.4(b), TDD-RED-first per §11.4.43/§11.4.115) BEFORE the pre-build sweep + main build proceed; the review iterates (re-review after each remediation) until no blocking findings remain. The review is itself anti-bluff (its conclusions are captured evidence per §11.4.5/§11.4.69; a rubber-stamp review of a defective batch = PASS-bluff). It is one of MULTIPLE STRONG LAYERS — complementing, never replacing, the §1 pre-build sweep, §11.4.92 multi-pass (author-side self-review; §11.4.125 adds the structurally-separated reviewer seam per §11.4.70), §11.4.108 four-layer fix-verification, §11.4.110 build-readiness verdict, and the post-build / runtime-on-clean-target / user-visible layers. When the permanent C-Media USB headset wins ALSA `card0`, the rockchip HDMI cards shift to card1/card2 → `card=0` "HDMI Out" port is physically the USB device → `APM failed to make available device 0x400 addr=card=0 error=1` → wrong TYPE → Arvus AVR labelled "Wired Headphone" + multichannel collapses to stereo. Broken LABELS + multichannel DOWNMIX are ONE defect — addressed by `snd_usb_audio.index=8` kernel-cmdline pin (`a52994a4`). Mandate (§11.4.111): every RK3588 binding to an enumerated resource MUST resolve by stable identifier — audio cards by ALSA `/proc/asound/card*/id` name; HDMI/display by DRM connector name (`HDMI-A-1`/`HDMI-A-2`, Fix #80); Ethernet by `eth\d`; storage by UUID. The `snd_usb_audio.index=8` pin (REQUIRES_REBUILD; runtime signature `grep snd_usb_audio.index=8 /proc/cmdline` + `/proc/asound/card0/id == rockchiphdmi0`) makes the static index correct again but keeps the brittle assumption — defense-in-depth follow-up (`qa-results/research_incorporation_20260603/AUDIO_PROPOSED_ISSUES.md`): reconcile HDMI ports by ALSA card NAME in `AudioDeviceInventory.connectDualHdmiPorts_l()` / `AudioPolicyManager`. Recommended gate `CM-RESOLVE-BY-NAME-NOT-INDEX` + `CM-COVENANT-114-111-PROPAGATION`. Research: `docs/research/audio_labeling_deep_20260603/ANALYSIS.md` + `docs/research/audio_multichannel_deep_20260603/ANALYSIS.md`.

Every captured-evidence gate MUST ship with a paired mutation test that mutates the gate's anchor + runs the gate + asserts the gate now FAILs. Absence of the paired mutation is itself a bluff.
Every change to the TARGET system (firmware, kernel, init/boot scripts, drivers, sysfs/devfreq/voltage/clock/thermal/regulator register writes, partition/bootloader/U-Boot, HAL, framework, prebuilts, device config) MUST ALWAYS be safe for BOTH (a) the target System itself — MUST NOT brick, boot-loop, corrupt data, or render the device unrecoverable — AND (b) the hardware it runs on — MUST NOT exceed safe electrical/thermal/voltage/clock limits or damage panels/storage/radios/regulators. Concrete obligations: (1) reversible-first — verify irreversible high-blast-radius changes (bootloader/U-Boot MD5, partition layout) against known-good values + capture a pre-op backup (§9.2) BEFORE applying; (2) NO unverified hardware-control writes — never write an unverified value to a voltage/clock/regulator/thermal-throttle/current-limit sysfs node or register that could exceed datasheet limits, the safe range established as FACT (§11.4.6), never guessed; (3) thermal/perf changes (forcing a performance governor, pinning the top OPP, disabling thermal management) MUST respect the device's cooling design, validated by captured thermal evidence; (4) flashing MUST use the sanctioned tool + a freshly-built integrity-verified image — never an ad-hoc partition write or stale/unverified artifact; (5) unprovable-safety ⇒ blocked — a change whose target/hardware safety cannot be established from captured evidence is treated as UNSAFE and blocked (§11.4.6 + §11.4.101 reversible-first + §11.4.123 rock-solid-proof). DISTINCT from §12 host-session safety: §12 protects the DEVELOPER's HOST + session; §11.4.133 protects the TARGET device + its hardware — both apply, neither weakens the other. Classification: universal (§11.4.17) — consuming project supplies its concrete hardware-control surfaces, datasheet-safe ranges, known-good bootloader/image hashes, and sanctioned flashing tool per §11.4.35. It does NOT use `config.json` `include`/`exclude` fields for file discovery. Filtering is done by a built-in ignore matcher seeded with defaults (`node_modules`, `vendor`, `dist`, `build`, `target`, `.venv`, `Pods`, `.next`) PLUS the project root `.gitignore`. To control indexing, use root-anchored `.gitignore` patterns with `!` negations for re-inclusion under default-skipped parents (e.g., `!/vendor/widevine_*` re-includes owned vendor code). **ALL SOURCE CODE MUST BE INDEXABLE** — including AOSP platform trees (`frameworks/`, `packages/`, `external/`, `art/`, `bionic/`, `cts/`, `kernel-5.10/`, `hardware/*/`, `vendor/`, `device/*/`). Only actual rubbish MAY be excluded: build outputs (`/out/`, `/prebuilts/`, `/rockdev/`), caches (`.gradle/`, `__pycache__/`), credentials/secrets (`/secrets/`, `/qa-results/`, `/recordings/`). A forked-AOSP project with 1M+ tracked files will produce a correspondingly large index (30-40 GB for first init), which is expected and correct — the index must represent the full codebase the AI agent cross-references. (3) Wire the `codegraph serve --mcp` server into every CLI agent the developers use — project-scoped + committed where supported (Claude Code `.mcp.json`, OpenCode `opencode.json`, Qwen Code `.qwen/settings.json`, Crush `.crush.json`), host-local otherwise (Kimi CLI `~/.kimi/mcp.json`); every config references the bare `codegraph` command on `PATH` (no hardcoded host path). (5) Document everything in `docs/CODEGRAPH.md`, kept in sync per §11.4.12 / §11.4.65. Every feature test exercising a user-visible behaviour MUST ship in TWO variants: a UI-driven variant (uiautomator-based, §11.4.48 surfaces A–E) AND an Intent/Broadcast-driven variant (`am start --es` / `am broadcast`-based). Either alone is a §11.4 PASS-bluff for the OPPOSITE half of the stack — UI catches app-side bugs (content selection, player surface allocation, MediaSession lifecycle, in-app overlays, back-button cleanup); Intent catches framework/system-server bugs (Intent extras parsing, `MediaCodec.configure` hook MIME routing, `IVideoOutputManager.registerVideoDecoder` bind timing, broadcast permission gating, headless cron automation paths).

Every test MUST leave the target in a quiescent state. Cleanup
Every test asserting audio/video output is genuinely playing/advancing MUST satisfy ALL of: (1) a single captured frame is NOT proof — prove LIVE, ADVANCING frames over a window via a freeze-detection oracle (near-duplicate/`freezedetect`-class OR perceptual-hash adjacent-frame distance, NOT byte-identical — byte-identity is only a pre-filter); (2) an independent frame-advance counter from the platform's compositor/decoder telemetry must increase (a different-domain oracle — flat ⇒ stuck decoder ⇒ FAIL even if pixels appear to move); (3) loading/buffering is a distinct state — wait for genuine playback-start, never false-FAIL a still-loading stream nor false-PASS a spinner (timeout+unreachable ⇒ SKIP per §11.4.3, timeout+reachable ⇒ FAIL); (4) not-stale-from-previous cross-check (new first frame ≠ previous last frame); (5) measured FPS / no-lost-frames within tolerance; (6) no-flash-on-the-wrong-output — high-frequency sampling of the non-target output during routing transitions, any content frame there ⇒ FAIL (content-protection regime classified, never guessed); (7) drive through the realistic feed/UI path, not deep-link shortcuts (UI-not-introspectable ⇒ operator-attended per §11.4.52, never fake-PASS); (8) metamorphic relations solve the oracle problem when there is no golden source (same content output-A vs output-B must match; paused ⇒ counter stops; 2× speed ⇒ ~2× advance); (9) full-reference quality metrics (SSIM/VMAF/ΔE2000) vs a golden source for owned content; (10) mutation-test every analyzer with a golden-good + golden-bad fixture pair so the analyzer itself cannot bluff (PASS on the golden-bad fixture = bluff gate — §1.1 applied to analyzers); (11) per-channel audio RMS/loudness (EBU R128) + XRUN/underrun census (a single aggregate RMS misses a dead channel); (12) OCR overlay/subtitle detection needs a per-word confidence floor + ROI (avoids both false-FAIL and false-PASS); (13) thresholds calibrated on the project's own fixtures, not hardcoded from literature (§11.4.6). Honest gap: true photon FPS at the sink has no clean software oracle — flag it, never claim it.

Every test asserting audio/video output is genuinely playing/advancing for the end user MUST satisfy ALL of: (1) **a single captured frame is NOT proof** — prove LIVE, ADVANCING frames over a steady-state window via a **freeze-detection oracle** (near-duplicate / `freezedetect`-class filter OR perceptual-hash adjacent-frame distance, **NOT byte-identical compare** — byte-identity is only a zero-cost pre-filter); (2) an **independent frame-advance counter from the platform's compositor/decoder telemetry** must increase across the window (a different-domain oracle — flat counter ⇒ stuck decoder ⇒ FAIL even if pixels appear to move); (3) **loading/buffering is a distinct state** — wait for genuine playback-start before judging liveness, never false-FAIL a still-loading stream nor false-PASS a spinner; timeout+unreachable ⇒ SKIP-with-reason per §11.4.3, timeout+reachable ⇒ FAIL; (4) **not-stale-from-previous cross-check** — new content's first frame ≠ previous content's last frame; (5) **measured FPS / no-lost-frames within tolerance**; (6) **no-flash-on-the-wrong-output** — sample the non-target output at high frequency during a routing transition, any content frame there ⇒ FAIL (content-protection regime classified explicitly, never guessed); (7) **drive through the realistic feed/UI path, not deep-link shortcuts** (shortcuts bypass the transition paths where bugs live; UI-not-introspectable ⇒ operator-attended fallback per §11.4.52, never fake-PASS); (8) **metamorphic relations solve the oracle problem when there is no golden source** (same content on output-A vs output-B must match; paused ⇒ counter stops; 2× speed ⇒ ~2× advance rate); (9) **full-reference quality metrics (SSIM/VMAF/ΔE2000) vs a golden source for owned content**; (10) **mutation-test every analyzer with a golden-good + golden-bad fixture pair** so the analyzer itself provably cannot bluff (an analyzer that PASSes its golden-bad fixture is a bluff gate — §1.1 applied to the analyzers); (11) **per-channel audio RMS/loudness (EBU R128) + XRUN/underrun census** — a single aggregate RMS misses a dead channel; (12) **OCR overlay/subtitle detection needs a per-word confidence floor + ROI** to avoid BOTH false-positive (false-FAIL) and false-negative (false-PASS); (13) **thresholds calibrated on the project's own fixtures, not hardcoded from literature** (§11.4.6 no-guessing).

Force-push is STRICTLY FORBIDDEN with NO exception — `git push --force`, `--force-with-lease`, `+<ref>`, or any history-rewriting overwrite of a remote ref, against EVERY repository this Constitution governs (main repo, this constitution submodule, every owned + nested submodule, every upstream). No operator-approval path, no "after a merge-first audit" path. The mandated 6-step integration procedure for any repo/submodule whose local has commits to publish OR whose mirrors diverged: (1) `git fetch --all --prune --tags` all remotes; (2) set the base to the LATEST commit on the canonical `main`/`master` branch (the most-advanced mirror tip); (3) carefully MERGE every change to be published on top of that base — union, preserve BOTH sides, NEVER `-s ours` / rebase / reset that drops commits (per §9 no-commit-loss); (4) resolve every conflict carefully — no conflict markers, no file dropped, gates/tests still pass; (5) commit the merge (stage only intended files, NEVER `git add -A` in a submodule per §11.4.30); (6) push to ALL upstreams — each push is a fast-forward because the merge commit descends from every mirror tip, so NO force is ever needed (if an upstream still rejects, return to step 1 for it, merge its new tip, re-validate, re-push). **TIGHTENS §11.4.41 / §11.4.71 / §9.2 / CONST-043 — the force-push escape hatch is REMOVED:** even WITH operator approval, even after a clean merge-first audit, force-push is forbidden, because the merge-onto-latest-main path is always available so force is never necessary. Those clauses' merge-first/fetch-first machinery stays in force as the integration discipline; only their terminal "...then force-push" step is struck.

Forensic anchor (genericised): a consumer project wired its full local CI gate as an automatic git `pre-push` hook (`core.hooksPath` → hook → multi-minute build/test/sweep stage on EVERY push). The result, captured 2026-07-26: routine pushes took many minutes each, and when one gate stage inside the hook failed or stalled, the push was rejected outright — the commit/push mechanism itself became blocked, with pending commits stranded locally and no operator-usable path forward short of a forbidden `--no-verify` bypass. The gate logic was sound; wiring it as an uninterruptible implicit hook on the commit/push code path was the architectural flaw — an edge-triggered enforcer (§11.4.233) placed directly on the operator's only forward path, violating the §2 single-entrypoint discipline by making the entrypoint unusable.

Forensic anchor (genericised): in one cycle a verification sweep produced five distinct mess states — (1) multiple concurrent same-purpose sweeps ran unintentionally (no single-owner-per-purpose claim); (2) a sweep HUNG on a consumer-blocked-on-an-unclosed-producer pipeline and was undetected because liveness was inferred from process-alive (a §11.4.201(6) FALSE-NULL: a wedged op and a progressing op returned the identical "process alive" signal); (3) stopping the owning subagent SILENTLY KILLED its child long-op because ownership was implicit (no handoff-on-stop); (4) a stale/non-growing log was read as live progress (the same false-null, reader-side); (5) an un-completable tooling gate blocked a release for hours (no escape to a terminal state). Per §11.4.102 Phase 4.5 these are ONE architectural state-management flaw, not five bugs: **there was no single source of truth for what long-op is running, who owns it, its state, and its PROVEN liveness** — the §11.4.196(F) configured≠in-use gap generalised to project long-ops, so every mess state was un-observable, and an un-observable bad state is a §11.4/§11.4.1 bluff at the orchestration layer.
